job.title: Consultant Anaesthetist | Tropical Queensland
job.description:
Consultant Anaesthetist | Tropical Queensland
Major Tertiary Referral Hospital | Package Up to $546,915

Advance your career within a major tertiary referral hospital offering an exceptional breadth of complex anaesthetic practice, outstanding professional benefits and an enviable tropical lifestyle.

You will join a large, supportive anaesthetic department delivering more than 16,000 procedures annually across 14 operating theatres. The position offers extensive clinical variety, excellent professional development opportunities and the chance to contribute to a respected tertiary service.

A well-connected domestic airport provides regular direct flights to major Australian cities, making travel home, professional conferences and weekend escapes easy.

The Opportunity
You will provide high-quality anaesthetic care across a diverse range of complex elective and emergency services, including:
  • Cardiac, thoracic and vascular surgery
  • Neurosurgery and neuroradiology
  • Paediatrics and tertiary obstetrics
  • Trauma and emergency surgery
  • Complex general, ENT, urology and plastic surgery
  • Acute pain and perioperative medicine
You will also contribute to registrar supervision, clinical teaching, governance, research, quality improvement and service development.

An Exceptional Tropical Lifestyle
Enjoy year-round warmth, affordable housing and minimal congestion, with beaches, tropical islands, national parks and the Great Barrier Reef within easy reach.
This is an outstanding opportunity to enjoy complex tertiary practice and career development without the cost and congestion of a capital city.

Benefits
  • Remuneration package up to $546,915 per annum
  • 50% attraction and retention allowance
  • 5% regional attraction allowance
  • Motor vehicle allowance of $21,000–$25,500
  • Professional development allowance of $21,500
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave
  • Four to six weeks of annual leave
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Potential relocation assistance
About You
To be considered, you will hold:
  • FANZCA or an international specialist qualification assessed as substantially comparable by ANZCA
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA or eligibility to obtain registration
  • Broad experience in complex elective and emergency anaesthesia
  • A commitment to collaborative practice, teaching and clinical excellence
Take the Next Step
Build your specialist career within a leading tertiary hospital while enjoying everything Tropical Queensland has to offer.

Apply today or contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
Phone: +61 401 010 048

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrists - Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities
job.description:
What’s on offer
  • Salary package of $400,000 – $550,000 p.a. plus relocation support
  • Be part of Queensland’s expanding IDD mental health services
  • Multiple positions across highly sought-after Queensland locations
  • Strong clinical leadership opportunities
  • Collaborative multidisciplinary teams
  • Generous leave, salary packaging and professional development
  • An enviable Queensland lifestyle, with beaches, hinterland, dining and cultural experiences on your doorstep
There’s never been a better time to build your future in Queensland
 
Queensland Health is investing $51.5 million over four years to expand specialist mental health services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. The program includes a statewide Centre of Excellence and 12 new multidisciplinary consultation-liaison teams, which will provide specialist assessment, treatment advice and support to improve mental health outcomes for people with intellectual disability. This statewide expansion is increasing demand for Australian and international psychiatrists whose principal area of expertise is intellectual and developmental disability psychiatry.
 
About the roles
 
These specialist roles involve the assessment and management of mental illness in people with intellectual and/or neurodevelopmental disabilities, including those with complex needs and challenging behaviours. Working within experienced multidisciplinary teams, you will provide expert psychiatric care, support individuals, families and carers, and contribute to clinical leadership and service development.
 
This is an opportunity to help shape the future of specialist IDD mental health services across Queensland while making a meaningful difference to the lives of people with disability.
 
About Queensland
 
Queensland offers more than a career - it offers an exceptional lifestyle. Enjoy a warm, sub-tropical climate, world-class beaches, spectacular natural landscapes, vibrant cities and welcoming regional communities. From Brisbane and the Gold Coast to the Sunshine Coast and regional Queensland, you can build a rewarding career while enjoying the space, sunshine and freedom that make Queensland one of Australia’s most desirable places to live. With excellent schools, thriving communities, diverse dining and entertainment, and endless opportunities to explore the outdoors, Queensland makes it easy to enjoy a fulfilling life both at work and beyond.

Relocating to Australia… support we can offer you
  • Forget Government Job Boards - We know our hospitals. We provide you with exclusive Psychiatrist job vacancies and direct link-ups with Mental Health Dept. Directors
  • Our recruitment service is FREE and personalised to your career and location requirements
  • Psychiatrist Peer to Peer Group Support with the RANZCP Specialist Assessment and Medical Board Applications
  • All Job applications prepared and submitted by our recruitment team.
  • Support with enrolling your children into leading private or state-run schools
  • Registered Migration Agent advice and support
Sound like you

Contact Jonathan Richards, your Psychiatry Recruitment Specialist, to find out more about these roles and all they have to offer.
 
Tel: 0422408729
 
Email: jonathanr@ccjobs.com.au

About Jonathan Richards

“I have 15+ years’ experience connecting Psychiatrists with the best job opportunities across Australia. It is my passion and privilege to ensure you are being provided with the best recruitment services available.”

job.title: Specialist Endocrinologist | Coastal Victoria | Package up to $440,000
job.description:
Specialist Endocrinologist | Coastal Victoria | Package up to $440,000
Live Where Others Holiday
Are you a Consultant Endocrinologist seeking a rewarding specialist position combining clinical excellence, academic opportunities and an exceptional coastal lifestyle?
A leading regional health service is seeking a Specialist Endocrinologist to join its growing medical team in one of Victoria’s most desirable coastal regions.

As the major specialist referral centre for a large regional catchment, the service provides comprehensive acute, subacute, specialist, community, mental health and aged-care services.
This is an exciting opportunity to help expand and shape regional endocrinology services while enjoying an outstanding work–life balance.

Why Make the Move?
Imagine finishing work just minutes from:
  • Stunning beaches and coastal walking trails
  • Seasonal southern right whale migrations
  • Award-winning restaurants, wineries and cafés
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • More affordable housing than metropolitan centres
  • A vibrant arts, cultural and sporting community
  • Easy access to Melbourne and the iconic Great Ocean Road
Enjoy a fulfilling specialist career without the congestion and long commutes of city living.

The Opportunity
As a Specialist Endocrinologist, you will:
  • Provide specialist outpatient clinics and inpatient consultation services
  • Deliver high-quality, evidence-based and patient-centred care
  • Collaborate with medical, nursing and allied health professionals
  • Participate in clinical governance, audits and quality improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to the development of clinical guidelines and contemporary models of care
  • Teach and mentor medical students, junior doctors and allied health professionals
  • Participate in research and academic activities through an established university partnership
  • Help shape and further develop endocrinology services within a growing regional health service
Appointments of up to full-time are available.

About You
Applicants should possess:
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with the Medical Board of Australia/AHPRA
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians in Endocrinology, or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Demonstrated specialist experience in Endocrinology
  • A commitment to clinical excellence and patient-centred care
  • Strong communication and multidisciplinary collaboration skills
  • Experience or interest in teaching and mentoring
  • An interest in research, clinical governance and service development
  • A commitment to continuing professional development
What’s On Offer
  • Attractive remuneration package of up to $440,000, dependent on experience and appointment conditions
  • Flexible appointment options up to full-time
  • Salary packaging benefits, including meals and entertainment
  • Novated leasing and additional superannuation contribution options
  • Relocation assistance
  • Professional development funding and study support
  • Teaching and research opportunities
  • Leadership development and mentoring programs
  • A welcoming and supportive specialist and multidisciplinary team
  • Excellent employment conditions
  • An exceptional work–life balance in a highly sought-after coastal region
Apply Now
If you are ready to advance your specialist career, help shape a growing endocrinology service and enjoy an exceptional coastal lifestyle, we would welcome your application.
For a confidential discussion about this opportunity, please contact:

job.title: Director of Medical Service/DMS
job.description:
Director of Medical Services | Coastal NSW | Executive Leadership
A career with purpose. A coastal lifestyle worth living.
Salary package up to $400k plus DMS managerial allowance

Are you an energetic and collaborative medical leader ready to influence the future of healthcare?
An outstanding opportunity is available for a Director of Medical Services to provide strategic leadership across a major regional hospital and its surrounding health services. Located in one of coastal New South Wales’ most attractive lifestyle regions, this role combines genuine executive influence with an enviable balance of beaches, waterways, national parks and welcoming communities.

Coastal Living Without Losing City Connections
Enjoy the space, affordability and natural beauty of coastal living while remaining well connected to major metropolitan centres.
The region is positioned along the Pacific Highway and North Coast rail corridor, providing convenient access to:
  • Newcastle – approximately two hours by road
  • Sydney – approximately 3.5 hours by road
  • Regular NSW TrainLink services connecting the region with Newcastle, Sydney and destinations along the North Coast
  • A nearby regional airport offering direct services to Sydney and Brisbane, with onward connections throughout Australia and internationally
  • Easy access to larger coastal centres for additional shopping, education, healthcare and entertainment
Professionally, you will also remain connected through strong partnerships with a leading university, a major medical research institute and a network of 11 experienced Directors of Medical Services across one of New South Wales’ largest health organisations.

The Lifestyle
Enjoy an exceptional coastal lifestyle without giving up professional challenge or career progression.
The region offers:
  • Pristine beaches and picturesque waterways
  • National parks, rainforests and scenic hinterland
  • Boating, fishing, surfing, cycling and bushwalking
  • A thriving local food, arts and sporting culture
  • Affordable housing and a relaxed, family-friendly community
  • Quality schools and essential services
  • Convenient access to major regional centres and Sydney
  • Domestic flight connections within easy reach
It is an ideal location for medical professionals seeking space, community and a healthier pace of life while remaining connected to larger cities.
This is a pivotal time to join the organisation, with a $100 million hospital redevelopment progressing towards its next stage. You will have a rare opportunity to help shape future clinical services, strengthen the medical workforce and contribute to healthcare planning that will benefit the community for generations.

The Opportunity
Working closely with the General Manager, Director of Nursing and broader executive team, you will provide leadership and professional oversight across medical services and the medical workforce.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Providing strategic and operational leadership across medical services
  • Supporting medical workforce planning, recruitment, credentialing and performance
  • Influencing the future direction and delivery of clinical services
  • Promoting clinical governance, patient safety and continuous improvement
  • Building a positive, accountable and inclusive workplace culture
  • Supporting medical leaders and empowering teams to deliver outstanding care
  • Contributing to the planning and implementation of the hospital redevelopment
  • Collaborating with an experienced network of medical administration executives across the wider health service
This is an opportunity to move beyond day-to-day administration and make a lasting contribution to the direction, culture and capability of an important regional healthcare service.

About You
You will be a respected and forward-thinking medical leader who brings energy, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to executive decision-making.
You will ideally demonstrate:
  • Appropriate medical registration with AHPRA
  • Significant experience in medical leadership, administration or management
  • Strong knowledge of clinical governance, workforce planning and quality improvement
  • The ability to lead organisational change and engage diverse stakeholders
  • A commitment to safe, patient-centred and high-quality healthcare
  • An inclusive leadership style that values and empowers people
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-management skills
The Hospital
You will join a significant regional referral hospital providing an extensive range of acute, emergency, surgical, medical and community-based services.
Backed by a substantial redevelopment program, the hospital is entering an exciting period of growth and transformation. The investment will support contemporary facilities, enhanced clinical capability and improved access to care for communities across the region.

The broader health organisation is one of the largest public health services in New South Wales, supporting more than 900,000 people and maintaining strong links with leading university and medical research institutions.

Benefits
  • Influential executive medical leadership position
  • Opportunity to shape a major hospital redevelopment
  • Supportive and experienced senior leadership network
  • Relocation and settlement assistance for you and your family
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Fitness Passport
  • Employee Assistance Program for employees and family members
  • Strong academic and medical research connections
  • Permanent and flexible employment arrangements may be considered
Take the Next Step
If you are ready to lead meaningful change and build your career in one of coastal New South Wales’ most appealing regions apply now.
job.salary: Salary package up to $400k plus DMS managerial allowance

job.title: Clinical Director of Medicine | Senior Medical Leadership | Coastal Regional NSW
job.description:
Clinical Director of Medicine | Senior Medical Leadership | Coastal Regional NSW
Lead, innovate and shape the future of a major Department of Medicine—just 30 minutes from a thriving coastal city and its beaches.
  • FRACP is an essential requirement
  • Approximately 50% clinical and 50% leadership
  • Contemporary, purpose-built regional hospital
  • Broad departmental leadership across multiple physician specialties
  • Attractive coastal-regional lifestyle with excellent transport connections
  • Relocation and onboarding assistance available
An outstanding opportunity is available for an accomplished Physician to provide strategic, clinical and operational leadership to a large and diverse Department of Medicine within a modern regional health service.

An Exceptional Regional Lifestyle
Enjoy the space, affordability and sense of community offered by regional living without sacrificing convenient access to city amenities.
The hospital is positioned approximately 30 minutes from a thriving coastal city, beautiful beaches and an established regional airport. Major road and rail connections provide convenient access to other key centres across New South Wales.

The surrounding region is renowned for its wineries, restaurants, national parks, quality schools and welcoming family-friendly communities.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior Physician seeking genuine leadership influence, modern clinical facilities and an enviable balance between career and lifestyle.

This influential role offers the scope to shape medical services, lead service redesign, strengthen physician education and training, and develop contemporary models of care across the department.
Approximately 50% of the position remains clinically focused, enabling you to maintain meaningful involvement in frontline patient care while leading departmental strategy, clinical governance, workforce development and service performance.

The Department
You will provide leadership across a comprehensive range of medical services, including:
Leadership across General Medicine, Cardiology, Oncology, Palliative Care, Gastroenterology, Nephrology, Endocrinology, Respiratory Medicine, Infectious Diseases, Hospital in the Home and Virtual Care

Working closely with senior hospital executives, clinical leaders and district-wide stakeholders, you will help develop sustainable, patient-centred services that respond to the evolving needs of the regional community.

The Opportunity
As Clinical Director of Medicine, you will:
  • Provide strategic, clinical and operational leadership across the Department of Medicine
  • Lead service planning, redesign and performance improvement initiatives
  • Oversee clinical governance, quality, safety and risk management
  • Guide medical workforce planning, recruitment, wellbeing and professional development
  • Strengthen physician education, supervision and training accreditation
  • Champion contemporary models of care, including Medical Assessment Units, rapid-access clinics, Hospital in the Home and virtual care
  • Support research and education through established university and medical research partnerships
  • Build productive relationships across specialties, services and external organisations
  • Represent the department at hospital and health-service leadership forums
  • Maintain an active clinical practice within General Medicine or your recognised physician subspecialty
About You
You will be an experienced, collaborative and forward-thinking medical leader with the credibility and vision to bring people together, lead change and deliver sustainable improvements.
To be considered, you must hold:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians—FRACP
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Senior clinical experience in General Medicine or a relevant physician subspecialty
You will also bring:
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in clinical governance, workforce management, service development or performance improvement
  • Experience leading change and improving clinical systems
  • A strong interest in physician education, supervision, training and accreditation
  • Highly developed communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills
  • A commitment to safe, evidence-based and patient-centred care
  • The ability to inspire teams and build a positive, accountable departmental culture
Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Senior leadership impact: Shape the future direction of a major Department of Medicine
  • Balanced portfolio: Approximately 50% clinical and 50% leadership responsibilities
  • Modern working environment: Join a contemporary, purpose-built hospital
  • Broad clinical scope: Lead General Medicine and an extensive range of physician subspecialties
  • Service innovation: Influence new and emerging models of hospital and community-based care
  • Education and training: Strengthen the department’s profile as a highly regarded physician training destination
  • Academic connections: Collaborate with established university and medical research partners
  • Professional development: Access leadership, education and research opportunities
  • Relocation support: Receive dedicated assistance with recruitment, onboarding and settling into the community
  • Employee benefits: Access salary packaging, professional development support, wellbeing programs and discounted fitness facilities
Apply Now
If you are an experienced Physician ready to take the next step in senior medical leadership, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.
To apply, please submit your current CV outlining your specialist qualifications, clinical background and medical leadership experience.

For a confidential discussion or to request a detailed position description, please contact:
Nicki Wade | Senior Recruitment Consultant
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Registered Nurse - Skin Cancer Nurse
job.description:
Skin Cancer Nurse (Registered Nurse)

Role Overview

Want to be part of a big national program that screens people for skin cancer at work? We're looking for nurses to join our team in cities like Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and more. You can work on a casual or contract basis, and we have jobs in both cities and rural areas. As a skin cancer nurse, you'll assess people's skin and moles, use special tools for a closer look, and figure out if anyone needs to see a doctor. You'll also keep track of everything in our records. It's a excellent way to help people stay healthy and catch any problems early.

Skills & Experience
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse registration
  • Experience in skin cancer screening, skin checks or mole checks
  • Strong clinical assessment and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage onsite screening sessions
  • Skin cancer/dermoscopy qualifications highly desirable
  • Mole mapping/melanography experience and own dermoscope advantageous
Benefits & Perks
  • Flexible casual & contract opportunities
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • National, regional and rural opportunities
  • Travel and other allowances where applicable
  • Training provided on relevant systems and processes
  • Ongoing opportunities within a growing national program
Referral reward

Introduce a Skin Cancer Nurse and receive a $750 incentive from us once eligibility conditions are met (T&Cs apply). Refer a Colleague | Healthcare Professionals 

About us

We are a boutique Healthcare recruitment agency with 30+ years’ experience connecting healthcare professionals to meaningful roles across Australia.

How to apply

If you're interested in this job, you can apply on SEEK or contact our team to discuss. And don't worry if this one isn't exactly what you're looking for - we have lots of other jobs available that might be a better suited for your skills.

job.title: Hospital Occupational Therapist
job.description:
• 6 month contract + possible extension
  • Inpatient caseload
  • Accommodation provided for 10 weeks

 
Experienced Hospital Occupational Therapist for a six month fixed term contract to start in September/October. Based just two hours from Melbourne, you’ll join a team of Occupational Therapists. The caseload is adults. It is a Grade 2 level role, experienced Grade 1 clinicians also welcome to apply.
 
The caseload will cover:
  • Inpatient caseload including neuro, ortho, ABI, stroke, GEM, reconditioning, elective surgeries, amputees
  • Great feedback from my current OTs
  • Experience with inpatients in a public hospital setting required
  • Grade 2 salary range - $90,000 - $105,000 + superannuation per annum
  • Six month fixed term contract + possible extension including leave accrual, paid public holidays etc…
  • Accommodation is provided for the first 10 weeks, in the dedicated allied health houses within walking distance of the hospital- inclusive of all bills.
 
The hospital main health service in the region. Services include; a 24-hour Emergency Department, Surgery, Medical, Women’s and Children’s, Rehabilitation and Palliative Care, Mental Health, Outpatients, community-based health programs and services in the surrounding towns.


Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable hours are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Registered Nurse - Skin Cancer Nurse
job.description:
Skin Cancer Nurse (Registered Nurse)

Role Overview

Want to be part of a big national program that screens people for skin cancer at work? We're looking for nurses to join our team in cities like Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and more. You can work on a casual or contract basis, and we have jobs in both cities and rural areas. As a skin cancer nurse, you'll assess people's skin and moles, use special tools for a closer look, and figure out if anyone needs to see a doctor. You'll also keep track of everything in our records. It's a excellent way to help people stay healthy and catch any problems early.

Skills & Experience
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse registration
  • Experience in skin cancer screening, skin checks or mole checks
  • Strong clinical assessment and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage onsite screening sessions
  • Skin cancer/dermoscopy qualifications highly desirable
  • Mole mapping/melanography experience and own dermoscope advantageous
Benefits & Perks
  • Flexible casual & contract opportunities
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • National, regional and rural opportunities
  • Travel and other allowances where applicable
  • Training provided on relevant systems and processes
  • Ongoing opportunities within a growing national program

job.title: Senior Specialist / Specialist – Interventional Cardiology
job.description:
Senior Specialist / Specialist – Interventional Cardiology
Regional Queensland | Establish a New Interventional Cardiology Service | Package Up to $564,939
Build a Service. Shape a Region. Advance Your Career.

An exceptional opportunity is available for an experienced Interventional Cardiologist to take a leading role in establishing and developing a new interventional cardiology service within a major regional referral hospital in Queensland.

Following significant investment in its cardiac services, the hospital now features a state-of-the-art Cardiac Hybrid Theatre, purpose-built Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory, expanded Cardiac Investigations Unit and dedicated 12-bed Cardiology Ward.

This is more than a procedural position. You will have the opportunity to establish clinical pathways, influence models of care, develop regional capability and help shape the future of specialist cardiac services across an extensive referral network.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Specialist or Specialist in Interventional Cardiology, you will deliver high-quality General and Interventional Cardiology services across the Coronary Care Unit, Cardiology Ward, outpatient clinics and Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

You will play a central role in establishing the hospital’s new interventional cardiology service while contributing to clinical leadership, education, governance and future service development.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Delivering comprehensive General and Interventional Cardiology services
  • Undertaking contemporary interventional procedures, including PCI
  • Participating in the development and delivery of primary PCI services
  • Establishing models of care, clinical pathways, protocols and referral processes
  • Providing clinical leadership in patient safety, clinical governance and quality improvement
  • Supporting the development of cardiac capability across the regional referral network
  • Supervising and teaching registrars, junior medical officers and Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory staff
  • Contributing to multidisciplinary education, research and professional development
  • Helping guide the future expansion of specialist cardiac services
The Hospital
This major regional referral hospital provides an extensive range of specialist, acute and emergency services to communities across a large geographical area.
The expanding cardiac service is supported by a growing multidisciplinary team of Cardiologists, Cardiac Physiologists, nurses, junior medical officers, allied health professionals and administrative staff.
The Cardiac Investigations Unit provides a comprehensive range of diagnostic services, including:

  • Transthoracic and transoesophageal echocardiography
  • Exercise and dobutamine stress echocardiography
  • Exercise stress testing
  • Tilt-table testing
  • Ambulatory ECG monitoring
  • Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring
With its newly developed interventional capability and purpose-built facilities, the hospital is entering an exciting period of clinical growth and establishing itself as a regional centre of excellence for cardiac care.

About You
We are seeking a collaborative and forward-thinking Specialist Cardiologist who offers:
  • Specialist qualifications in Cardiology
  • Eligibility for specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Fellowship-trained or equivalent contemporary experience in Interventional Cardiology
  • Current PCI procedural experience
  • Experience participating in primary PCI services
  • Strong General Cardiology capability
  • A commitment to clinical governance, patient safety and service improvement
  • An interest in clinical leadership, service establishment and capability development
  • Strong communication, teaching and multidisciplinary collaboration skills
Internationally trained specialists who have been assessed as substantially comparable, or who may be eligible for an appropriate specialist registration pathway, are encouraged to enquire.

Remuneration and Benefits

The total remuneration package is valued at up to $564,939 per annum and may include:
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • 17.5% annual leave loading
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave
  • $22,145 professional development allowance
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Overtime, recall and on-call allowances, where applicable
  • Attraction and retention incentives
  • Granted private practice arrangements, where applicable
  • Teaching, research and academic appointment opportunities
  • Relocation and immigration assistance for eligible applicants
An Attractive Regional Queensland Lifestyle
Enjoy the professional scope of a major referral hospital while benefiting from the space, convenience and relaxed pace of regional Queensland.
The region offers established schools, university facilities, shopping, dining, sporting amenities and welcoming communities. Housing is more attainable than in many capital cities, commutes are shorter, and spectacular beaches, islands and national parks are within easy reach.

This is an attractive destination for specialists and families seeking:
  • A senior clinical career with genuine influence
  • A relaxed and family-friendly lifestyle
  • More attainable housing
  • Shorter commuting times
  • Access to beaches, islands and outdoor recreation
  • Strong educational and community facilities
  • Convenient air connections to a major capital city
Why This Opportunity Stands Out
  • Establish and shape a new interventional cardiology service
  • Work within newly developed, purpose-built cardiac facilities
  • Influence cardiac care across an extensive regional referral network
  • Combine procedural practice with leadership, teaching and service development
  • Access a remuneration package valued at up to $564,939 per annum
  • Enjoy an attractive regional Queensland lifestyle
  • Receive specialist recruitment, registration, immigration and relocation support
Interested in Learning More?
Apply today with your current CV or contact Nicki Wade, Senior Recruitment Consultant, for a confidential discussion.

Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Locum Hospital Speech Pathologist / Senior Hospital Speech Pathologist
job.description:
• ASAP start for 3-4 weeks
  • Travel and accommodation available
  • Locum rates upto $76.90 + super + tax benefits

 
Experienced Speech Pathologist required for this role based in regional New South Wales. The role is based 6 hours from Sydney. You will work alongside a multidisciplinary allied health team. There is a level 2 role or a level 3 role available. ASAP start for 3-4 weeks.
 
The caseload focuses on acute inpatients, including acquired communication and swallowing impairments on background neurodegenerative conditions, acquired brain injury, head and neck cancer and other medical conditions. Acquired communication disorders covers the range of speech, voice, language, and fluency disorders.
 

Open to Level 2 & 3 clinicians. 
  • Accommodation is available
  • Travel allowance TBC
  • Locum rates upto $76.90 + super, dependent on experience + potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $8 dollars more an hour!)
 

The Riverina region of NSW is known as the ‘food bowl’ of the state for good reason. Produce thrives here, and much of it envelops the location, from grapes to oranges and everything in between.

 
Explore the town’s fascinating Italian heritage while visiting wineries, restaurants and museums, and linger for festivals celebrating this rich food and wine culture.  
 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.
 
 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrist – Older Adult Mental Health
job.description:
Consultant Psychiatrist – Older Adult Mental Health
Permanent Full-Time or Part-Time | Melbourne
Join one of Victoria’s largest and most clinically diverse public mental health services in a permanent Consultant Psychiatrist position specialising in older adult mental health and wellbeing.
This is an outstanding opportunity to work within a highly regarded multidisciplinary service while enjoying the lifestyle and professional advantages of metropolitan Melbourne.
The Opportunity
The Older Adult Mental Health and Wellbeing Service provides comprehensive specialist care across inpatient, community and residential care settings.
You will provide clinical leadership and specialist psychiatric care for older adults experiencing complex mental illness, including behavioural and psychological symptoms associated with dementia.
Referrals are received from:
  • Acute aged psychiatry inpatient units
  • Community mental health and assessment teams
  • Emergency departments
  • Medical and surgical wards
  • Residential aged-care facilities
  • Intensive community treatment services
You will join an established team of Consultant Psychiatrists supported by registrars, nursing staff, allied health professionals and community-based clinicians.

Why You’ll Love This Role
  • Permanent full-time or part-time options
  • Established and well-resourced older adult mental health service
  • Strong consultant peer support
  • Diverse inpatient, community and residential care exposure
  • Opportunities to contribute to service planning and development
  • Active teaching and specialist registrar examination preparation
  • Extensive clinical research opportunities
  • Close links with a leading Australian university
  • Professional development courses and seminars
  • Salary packaging and employee benefits
  • Discounted onsite parking and access to an onsite gym
Enjoy Metropolitan Melbourne
Based in Melbourne’s thriving south-east, this position provides access to outstanding schools, diverse dining and shopping precincts, beautiful parks and established family-friendly communities.
The region offers convenient access to Melbourne’s CBD, the Mornington Peninsula, Bayside beaches and the Dandenong Ranges, providing an ideal balance between metropolitan convenience and weekend lifestyle.

About You
You will be a collaborative and experienced psychiatrist with an interest in improving outcomes for older adults living with mental illness.
Applicants must have:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Current or eligible specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Qualifications permitting specialist practice in Victoria
  • Strong multidisciplinary and clinical leadership capabilities
  • An interest in recovery-oriented and person-centred care
Internationally trained psychiatrists with an equivalent specialist qualification and eligibility for specialist registration in Australia are encouraged to enquire.

Apply Now
If you are seeking a permanent Consultant Psychiatrist position offering metropolitan living, clinical diversity, academic links and genuine opportunities to influence service development, we would welcome a confidential discussion.

Please submit your current CV or contact us to learn more.

job.title: Specialist General Surgeon | Coastal Victoria
job.description:
Specialist General Surgeon | Coastal Victoria
Staff Specialist or VMO | Flexible Appointment up to Full-Time
Exceptional Coastal Lifestyle | Relocation and Registration Support

CC Medical is recruiting an experienced Specialist General Surgeon to join a leading regional health service in one of Victoria’s most attractive coastal communities.
This is an excellent opportunity to secure a rewarding surgical appointment offering broad clinical exposure, a collaborative multidisciplinary environment and genuine work–life balance.

Live Where Others Holiday
Located on Victoria’s spectacular southwest coast, this vibrant regional city offers an enviable lifestyle surrounded by beaches, natural attractions and welcoming communities.

Enjoy:
  • Beautiful beaches and dramatic coastal scenery
  • Whale watching, national parks and scenic walking trails
  • Excellent public and private schooling options
  • Affordable housing compared with metropolitan Victoria
  • A safe and family-friendly community
  • Outstanding restaurants, wineries and regional produce
  • Easy access to the Great Ocean Road
  • Convenient road and rail connections to Melbourne
  • Short commutes and genuine work–life balance
This is an ideal opportunity for a surgeon seeking meaningful clinical work without sacrificing lifestyle, family time or professional development.

The Opportunity
You will provide high-quality general surgical services across:
  • Elective and emergency surgery
  • Inpatient and outpatient care
  • Clinical assessment and ongoing patient management
  • Multidisciplinary clinical activities
  • Clinical governance and quality improvement
  • Development of regional surgical services
The appointment can be structured as a Staff Specialist or VMO position, with flexible hours available up to full-time. Classification and remuneration will be commensurate with experience.

What’s on Offer
  • Staff Specialist or flexible VMO appointment
  • Flexible hours available up to full-time
  • Attractive public health employment conditions
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Novated leasing and additional superannuation options
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Supportive and collaborative surgical team
  • Broad and professionally rewarding clinical caseload
  • Opportunity to contribute to service growth and improvement
  • Guidance with registration, relocation and onboarding where required
About You
To be considered, you will:
  • Hold FRACS in General Surgery or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Be eligible for specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Demonstrate broad competence and experience in General Surgery
  • Be committed to safe, high-quality and patient-centred care
  • Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Demonstrate an interest in clinical governance and service development
Apply Now
If you are ready to combine a rewarding surgical career with an exceptional coastal lifestyle, we would welcome your application.
Click Apply and submit your current CV. For a confidential discussion or further information, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant | CC Medical
Phone: 0401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Specialist Obstetrician & Gynaecologist
job.description:
Specialist Obstetrician & Gynaecologist
Regional NSW | Specialist or VMO | Newly Developed Hospital
Salary package up to $380k
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Specialist Obstetrician and Gynaecologist to join a collaborative multidisciplinary team at a key regional referral hospital in NSW.
  • Join a major regional referral hospital
  • Work within a new, purpose-built clinical facility
  • Staff Specialist and flexible VMO options available
  • Broad Obstetrics and Gynaecology practice
  • Relocation, registration and immigration support may be available
  • Regular direct flights to Sydney
The hospital has recently opened a purpose-built clinical services building as part of a $250 million redevelopment. The contemporary facility includes expanded maternity, birthing, paediatric, perioperative, intensive care, emergency and medical imaging services.
The Lifestyle
Enjoy affordable regional living without feeling disconnected. The area is renowned for its Italian heritage, multicultural community, wineries, restaurants, fresh produce and relaxed family-friendly lifestyle.
Benefits include:
  • Affordable housing and excellent schools
  • Short, stress-free commutes
  • Outstanding food, wine and regional produce
  • Excellent sporting and recreational facilities
  • A welcoming, family-oriented community
  • Regular direct flights to Sydney with Qantas and Rex
The Opportunity
You will provide comprehensive Obstetrics and Gynaecology services across inpatient, outpatient, labour ward, theatre and on-call settings.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Providing antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care
  • Managing acute and elective gynaecological presentations
  • Undertaking gynaecological surgery
  • Participating in clinics, theatre and the on-call roster
  • Supervising junior doctors and GP Obstetricians
  • Contributing to teaching, clinical governance and quality improvement
  • Supporting the continued development of regional women’s health services
Appointments may be considered under either a Staff Specialist or flexible VMO arrangement.
The Hospital
This Level 4 regional referral hospital provides Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Paediatrics, Emergency Medicine, General Medicine, General Surgery, Intensive Care, Oncology and other specialist services.
The department is supported by modern diagnostic facilities and experienced medical, midwifery, nursing and allied health teams.
About You
You will require:
  • FRANZCOG and specialist registration with AHPRA; or
  • Overseas specialist qualifications – assessed by RANZCOG or eligible via expedited pathway
  • Recent broad Obstetrics and Gynaecology experience
  • Substantial gynaecological surgical experience
  • Strong communication, leadership and teamwork skills
  • Availability to participate in the on-call roster
What’s on Offer?
  • Staff Specialist or VMO appointment options
  • Attractive NSW Health remuneration
  • Regional recruitment and relocation assistance
  • Salary packaging and professional development support
  • Teaching and leadership opportunities
  • Registration and immigration support for eligible international specialists
Interested in This Opportunity?
This is an excellent opportunity to join a major regional referral hospital offering newly developed facilities, broad clinical practice and flexible Staff Specialist or VMO appointment options.
Applications are welcomed from specialists with FRANZCOG and specialist registration with AHPRA, as well as overseas-trained specialists assessed by RANZCOG or eligible via the expedited pathway.

To apply, please click Apply Now and submit your current CV. For a confidential discussion, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

All applications and enquiries will be treated in strict confidence

job.title: Locum Senior Hospital Occupational Therapist
job.description:
• 21st September for 8 weeks
  • Accommodation available + travel assistance
  • Upto $80 per hour + super + tax benefits
  • Living away from home tax benefits – upto $8 extra per hour!

 
Experienced Occupational Therapist required for hospital based role in the Northern Territory. You will join team of 100 allied health clinicians, including other Occupational Therapists, Podiatrists, Physiotherapists, Speech Pathologists, Dietitians, Social Workers, Chaplain, ALO. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums.
 
  • 21st September for 8 weeks
  • The caseload is a mix of acute caseload (renal, surgical, orthopaedics, palliative care, medical). Hand therapy experience would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Team leadership experience preferred
  • Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super
  • Option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay upto $8 per hour
  • ABN payment also an option!
  • Hospital experience is mandatory
  • You need to have or be eligible for Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) status.
  • Work hours are 8am to 4.21pm
  • Driver’s licence is preferred but not essential.
  • Opportunity for remote trips if desired
  • The team is very social.
  • Relocation assistance of upto $1000 and subsidised accommodation available. The accommodation is on site, so less than 5 min to walk to work and 10 minutes to town.

Join this large allied health team, including some of my other locums. All have extended their time with this hospital. The team are inclusive and social.


85% of the caseload is indigenous, with 50% coming in from remote communities. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums and this is a great chance to develop your skill set. If you like the outdoors, the lifestyle here is fab! 


The location is a great base for exploring the natural wonders of the Outback including: Uluru, Kata Tjuta, Kings Canyon, the West MacDonnell Ranges and the Larapinta Trail, the Simpson Desert and the gorgeous NT watering holes. It’s also a fascinating spot to explore Australia’s Aboriginal culture.


Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.


To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

 
Register today for information on all of our vacancies.
 
View all our vacancies here: www.ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Emergency Medicine Registrar / PHO | Coastal Queensland
job.description:
Emergency Medicine Registrar / PHO | Coastal Queensland
Salary package up to $170k +
ACEM-Accredited Department | Temporary Full-Time | 76 Hours per Fortnight

Advance your emergency medicine career in a modern regional referral hospital while enjoying an exceptional tropical coastal lifestyle.

We are seeking Emergency Medicine Registrars and Principal House Officers to join a supportive and well-established Emergency Department in one of Queensland’s most desirable regional locations.

Live the Tropical Coastal Lifestyle
Imagine finishing your shift and having beaches, tropical islands, national parks and the Great Barrier Reef within easy reach.
The region offers:
  • A warm climate and year-round outdoor lifestyle
  • Beautiful beaches and easy access to tropical islands
  • Boating, fishing, hiking and reef adventures
  • Affordable housing compared with major metropolitan centres
  • Shorter commutes and a relaxed pace of life
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly communities
  • Cafés, restaurants and a welcoming regional community
  • Direct flights to major Australian centres
The Opportunity
You will provide high-quality emergency medical care as part of an experienced multidisciplinary team while gaining exposure to a diverse range of adult and mixed emergency presentations.
The department features:
  • 21 acute treatment bays
  • Two resuscitation bays
  • Four high-dependency bays
  • 12 consultation bays
  • A dedicated 14-bed Short Stay Unit
  • Broad regional, rural and coastal referral exposure
  • Excellent clinical supervision and education
You will also contribute to clinical education, service development, quality improvement and the ongoing delivery of an effective and equitable emergency service.

Accredited Emergency Medicine Training
This is an excellent opportunity for doctors seeking recognised emergency medicine training and career progression.
The department is accredited for:
  • ACEM Specialist Fellowship Training
  • ACEM Tier 3 Training – up to 12 months
  • ACEM Foundational, Intermediate and Advanced Associateship programs
  • ACRRM Advanced Skills Training
  • RACGP Core Generalist Training
About You
To be considered, you will generally require:
  • A recognised medical degree
  • Registration with the Medical Board of Australia
  • At least four years of postgraduate clinical experience
  • Previous emergency medicine or acute-care experience
  • Strong communication and multidisciplinary teamwork skills
  • A commitment to clinical education and continuous improvement
Live the Tropical Coastal Lifestyle
Imagine finishing your shift and having beaches, tropical islands, national parks and the Great Barrier Reef within easy reach.
The region offers:
  • A warm climate and year-round outdoor lifestyle
  • Beautiful beaches and easy access to tropical islands
  • Boating, fishing, hiking and reef adventures
  • Affordable housing compared with major metropolitan centres
  • Shorter commutes and a relaxed pace of life
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly communities
  • Cafés, restaurants and a welcoming regional community
  • Direct flights to major Australian centres
This is an outstanding opportunity to gain valuable emergency medicine experience without sacrificing lifestyle.

Take the Next Step
If you are seeking accredited emergency medicine training, diverse clinical experience and the opportunity to advance your career in coastal Queensland, we would welcome your application.
Click Apply and submit your current CV. For a confidential discussion or further information, please contact Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant, on 0401 010 048 or at nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

job.title: Specialist/Consultant Anaesthetist | Coastal Victoria
job.description:
Specialist/Consultant Anaesthetist | Coastal Victoria
Permanent Full-Time | Package up to $440,000 | Relocation Assistance
IMGs assessed as substantially comparable or eligible through the Expedited Specialist Pathway will also be considered

Live Where Others Holiday
Imagine finishing your theatre list and being only minutes from some of Australia’s most spectacular coastline.
Spend your weekends exploring beautiful beaches and national parks, cycling scenic waterfront trails, visiting renowned wineries and restaurants, or watching southern right whales migrate along the coast.
This is an outstanding opportunity to join a leading regional referral centre, advance your specialist career and work within a collaborative, highly regarded anaesthetic team—all while enjoying an exceptional coastal lifestyle.

The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Specialist/Consultant Anaesthetist to deliver high-quality anaesthetic, perioperative and pain-management services within a supportive multidisciplinary environment.
You will work alongside salaried specialists and Visiting Medical Officers, contributing to clinical care, education, service development and clinical governance.

The role offers opportunities to further develop your professional interests in:
  • Perioperative medicine
  • Intensive care medicine
  • Acute and chronic pain management
  • Quality improvement and clinical governance
  • Medical education, supervision and training
  • Leadership and service development
You will enjoy genuine professional autonomy, varied clinical exposure and excellent support from experienced colleagues within a modern regional health service affiliated with the Deakin University Clinical School.

Why You’ll Love Living Here
  • Spectacular coastline and renowned beaches
  • Whale watching, national parks and outdoor recreation
  • Award-winning restaurants, wineries and local produce
  • Affordable housing compared with metropolitan areas
  • Excellent public and private schooling options
  • Welcoming, family-friendly community
  • Relaxed coastal lifestyle with convenient access to Melbourne
Position Details
  • Permanent full-time appointment
  • 76 hours per fortnight
  • Attractive remuneration package of up to $440,000
  • Relocation assistance available
  • Generous salary-packaging benefits
  • Professional development support
  • Leadership and mentoring opportunities
  • Excellent work–life balance
Essential Requirements
To be considered for this position, you will require:
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with AHPRA
  • FANZCA or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Experience practising independently as a Specialist Anaesthetist
  • A strong commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and quality improvement
  • Excellent communication and multidisciplinary teamwork skills
  • Experience supervising, teaching and mentoring junior medical staff
Internationally qualified Specialist Anaesthetists assessed as substantially comparable, or who may be eligible through the Expedited Specialist Pathway, are encouraged to apply.

Apply or Enquire
Ready to combine an outstanding specialist opportunity with an exceptional coastal lifestyle?
Click Apply Now to submit your CV. For a confidential discussion about the position, registration pathways or relocation support, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical
E: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
Ph: +61 401 010 048

job.title: Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist
job.description:
• September start for 8-12 weeks ++
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation 

 
Experienced Podiatrist required for role with regional health service, located approximately seven hours drive from Adelaide (there is an airport in town). You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP. 8-12 weeks  ++ in duration.
 
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be proficient in high risk wound care but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Sunrise experience preferred for clinical documentation needs
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
 
 
The Eyre and Far North covers almost 440,000 square kilometres of spectacular South Australia, supporting about 40,000 people living around Eyre Peninsula and the Far North of the state.


With its ancient outback landscapes and culture, boutique vineyards, renowned oyster farms and Australia’s best-kept-secret surf coast, the Eyre Peninsula and Far North offers a lifestyle that will inspire and energise you. The region enjoys a Mediterranean style climate so there’s plenty of opportunity to enjoy everything the region has to offer. From surfing and fishing to hiking and exploring the outback – create your best life, right here.



To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Locum Hospital Occupational Therapist
job.description:
• September for 3 months
  • Acute/palliative care caseload
  • Locum rates, travel + accomm

 
Experienced Occupational Therapist required for vacancy based in regional New South Wales. The role is to start in September for three months + possible extension. You will work alongside a large allied health team. Full time hours, Monday – Friday.
 
This caseload will cover:
  • Acute inpatient caseload
  • Palliative care
  • Accommodation provided, close to the facility
  • Return petrol costs or flight reimbursed (from a major city)
  • Pool car available for shopping trips if needed

Locum rates dependent on experience + potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $8 dollars more an hour!).
 
 
The legendary outback city is rich with history, a vibrant artistic community and a cast of colourful characters. Discover amazing galleries, famous sculptures, unique museums and towering mining landmarks in Australia’s first heritage-listed city.
 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

job.title: Registered Nurse - Remote Primary Health Contracts
job.description:
Remote Primary Health Contracts - N4 & N5 Rural & Remote Nursing


The Opportunity

Take on a rewarding Remote Area Nurse (RAN) role delivering comprehensive primary health care and population health services to Indigenous communities across remote Australia. RANs work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams and, in many locations, practise autonomously without a Doctor onsite, managing presentations independently while responding to emergency and on-call situations within the community.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Primary health care and emergency response
  • Acute and chronic disease management
  • Child and adult immunisations
  • Child and sexual health
  • Well-person screening
  • Maternity emergency care
  • Patient assessment, treatment planning, and health education
  • Clinical documentation and care coordination
  • On Call emergency Situations
These remote clinics rely heavily on experienced RANs and Nurse Unit Managers to assess, stabilise, manage, and refer patients appropriately in line with remote healthcare protocols and CARPA guidelines.

Essential Requirements: 
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse (Division 1)
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Recent Remote Area Nursing or remote Primary Health Care experience in Australia
  • Strong knowledge of CARPA guidelines is essential
  • Ability to work autonomously in isolated communities
  • Confidence managing emergencies and acute presentations
  • Experience working alongside Aboriginal Health Practitioners
  • Willing to travel interstate
  • Current manual driver licence
Essential Certifications & Training
  • Remote Emergency Care (REC) Certificate – CRANAplus or equivalent
  • Midwifery Emergency Care (MEC) Certificate – CRANAplus or equivalent
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) / Advanced Life Support (ALS) – Current certification required
  • Immunisation Provider Certificate – Including Understanding Vaccines and the National Immunisation Program
  • 4WD Manual Off-Road Driving Certificate – Experience and certification in manual 4WD remote/off-road driving 
  • Ability to meet NT Health compliance requirements
Benefits & Perks
  • Competitive rates of $102 – $118 per hour + super (depending on experience)
  • Additional on-call allowances where applicable
  • Travel and accommodation provided for eligible contracts
  • Flexible engagement options: ABN, PAYG, or salary packaging partner option-  - tax savings of $500+ weekly
  • Weekly allowance provided of $175 towards (out of pocket T & C apply)
  • Flexibility to choose contracts that suit your lifestyle and availability
About us

CC Medical is a boutique medical recruitment agency with 30+ years’ experience partnering with leading remote health providers to connect experienced Remote Area Nurses with autonomous, clinically diverse contracts across some of Australia’s most rewarding and professionally challenging settings. These opportunities are suited to nurses who thrive in autonomous practice, are confident managing emergency presentations prior to retrieval, and are passionate about delivering culturally safe, community-led primary healthcare in remote Australia.
 
Referral reward

Introduce a Remote Area Nurse and receive a $750 bonus from us once eligibility conditions are met (T&Cs apply). Refer a Friend | Healthcare Professionals | CC Medical

How to apply

 Apply now via SEEK or contact contact the CC Medical team to discuss current Remote Area Nursing opportunities and locations.

job.title: Locum Hospital Dietitians required across AUS
job.description:
• Hospital, Generalist and Paediatric caseloads
  • Travel + accommodation
  • Locum rates $$


Experienced Dietitians required for vacancies across Australia. Please see a small selection of our latest vacancies:
 
 
 
SW QLD - Locum Senior Hospital Dietitian - 14th September – 2nd October
 
HP3 or HP4 Dietitian required for locum with remote health service based in South West Queensland. You will join a small allied health team and cover a varied caseload including:
  • Inpatients
  • Outpatients
  • Community
  • Outreach
  • Full time hours, Monday – Friday
  • 14th September – 2nd October
  • Join my other locums!
  • Please only respond if you have current APD status
  • Experienced Hospital Dietitians required, this role is not suitable for graduates
 
Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super dependent on years of experience + potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $8 dollars more an hour!)
 
Accommodation provided. $200 towards travel, each way.

This Outback town offers a real Aussie adventure. Great feedback from previous locums!
 
 


NT - Locum Senior Hospital Dietitian - 7th September for 8 weeks

Experienced Dietitian required for hospital based role in the Northern Territory. You will join team of 100 allied health clinicians, including Occupational Therapists, Podiatrists, Physiotherapists, Speech Pathologists, Dietitians, Social Workers, Chaplain, ALO. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums.
 
  • 7th September for 8 weeks
  • Acute care or renal experience required
  • The caseload is acute care- ICU, paediatrics, renal, surgical general medical and outpatients, gastro- including PEG and IBD. A lot of opportunities for unique experiences and professional development including eating disorders, motivational interviewing and cultural engagement.
  • Team leadership experience preferred
  • Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super
  • Option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay upto $8 per hour
  • ABN payment also an option!
  • Hospital experience is mandatory
  • You need to have or be eligible for Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) status.
  • Work hours are 8am to 4.21pm
  • Driver’s licence is preferred but not essential.
  • Opportunity for remote trips if desired
  • The team is very social.
  • Relocation assistance of upto $1000 and subsidised accommodation available. The accommodation is on site, so less than 5 min to walk to work and 10 minutes to town.

Join this large allied health team, including some of my other locums. All have extended their time with this hospital. The team are inclusive and social.


85% of the caseload is indigenous, with 50% coming in from remote communities. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums and this is a great chance to develop your skill set. If you like the outdoors, the lifestyle here is fab! 


The location is a great base for exploring the natural wonders of the Outback including: Uluru, Kata Tjuta, Kings Canyon, the West MacDonnell Ranges and the Larapinta Trail, the Simpson Desert and the gorgeous NT watering holes. It’s also a fascinating spot to explore Australia’s Aboriginal culture.
 
 

 
Expressions of interest for Remote NSW - Senior Paediatric Dietitian - level 3
  • Contract until 30th June 2027
  • Focus on antenatal/paediatrics (mainly community based)
  • Salary range from $121,568 - $125,507 + superannuation
Enjoy a true “Oasis in the Outback”, this location is a thriving regional town in far west NSW full of diversity, history and character. Being Australia’s first city to be Nationally Heritage Listed, this location is a culturally rich town with a vibrant art scene with over 20 galleries! The unique attractions, festivals and beautiful natural landscapes see tourists flock from all over, but the ones who stay quickly fall in love with the place and its liveability.
 
With a population just shy of 20,000, the town is small enough to allow for a relaxed country lifestyle, while big enough to provide all the desired facilities of a regional hub including major supermarkets and retail stores, excellent schools (7 primary & 2 high), multiple gyms & aquatic centre, well-known fast food franchises and a plethora of trendy restaurants, pubs and cafés.
 
You will have a:
  • Tertiary qualification in Dietetics and eligible for Membership of Dietitian’s Australia and/or APD status, with a minimum of 3 years post graduate experience.
  • Demonstrated clinical experience in Paediatric and Antenatal Health , including the assessment and management of various clinical presentations.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver Dietetic Services in Hospital, Community Health settings, private residences and outreach locations.
  • Strong communication, documentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with multi-disciplinary teams like CAFN, Midwifery and Paediatrics, GP’s, community NGO’s
  • Experience in education and support of patients, families and carers, including the ability to build capacity within Paediatric teams.
  • Current unrestricted NSW Driver’s Licence, and willingness to travel across the Far West LHD to deliver care, with possible over night stays.
  • Experience in delivering and co-ordinating, Community Health Promotion programs.
  • Demonstrated leadership and supervision experience, including the ability to support junior staff/students and contribute to strategic planning and service improvement initiatives. Ability to actively participate in the planning, implementation, evaluation and reporting on programs.

 
 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.


To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au



My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.
 
Register today for information on all of our vacancies.
 
View all our vacancies here: www.ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Psychiatrist – Multiple Opportunities
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Psychiatrist – Multiple Opportunities
Victoria–NSW Border | Flexible FTE | Package Up to $400,000+
Direct daily flights to Melbourne and Sydney

Are you a psychiatrist seeking meaningful clinical work, genuine career progression and a better work–life balance?
One of Australia’s largest regional health services is expanding its Mental Health Division and recruiting Consultant Psychiatrists across several specialist teams.

Current Opportunities
  • Adult Inpatient Psychiatry
  • Infant, Child and Youth Mental Health
  • Adult Community Mental Health and Triage
  • Older Persons Mental Health
Whether your interests lie in acute inpatient psychiatry, community mental health, older persons’ services or child and adolescent psychiatry, opportunities are available to align with your expertise.

Enjoy an Outstanding Regional Lifestyle
Located on the picturesque Murray River between Melbourne and Sydney, this thriving regional centre offers affordable living, excellent services and an enviable work–life balance.
Enjoy:
  • Affordable family homes and shorter commutes
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Vibrant cafés, restaurants and local wineries
  • River walks, cycling trails and nearby national parks
  • Ski fields within easy reach during winter
  • Direct daily flights to Melbourne and Sydney
  • A welcoming and family-friendly community
The Opportunity
You will join a supportive multidisciplinary team delivering high-quality psychiatric care across inpatient and community services.
Your responsibilities may include:
  • Providing specialist psychiatric assessment and treatment
  • Delivering clinical leadership within multidisciplinary teams
  • Supervising Registrars, Fellows and Junior Medical Officers
  • Teaching medical students through the University of Melbourne
  • Participating in clinical governance, quality improvement and service development
  • Contributing to a supported on-call and weekend roster
Flexible full-time and part-time appointments are available.

Why Consider This Health Service?
  • One of Australia’s largest and fastest-growing regional health services
  • Multiple psychiatry subspecialties within one organisation
  • Supportive and experienced Consultant team
  • Strong partnership with the University of Melbourne
  • Opportunities for teaching, research, leadership and career development
  • Modern clinical facilities, including a recently opened Emergency Department
  • Major hospital redevelopment currently underway
About You
You will hold one of the following:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists and eligibility for specialist registration with Ahpra
  • An international specialist psychiatry qualification assessed as substantially comparable by RANZCP
  • Eligibility for specialist registration through an applicable expedited specialist pathway
You will also demonstrate a commitment to collaborative care, clinical leadership, teaching and the ongoing development of mental health services.

Remuneration
An attractive remuneration package of up to $400,000+ is available, depending on experience, seniority, employment arrangements and applicable allowances.

If you are considering a move to regional Australia or simply looking for a specialist position offering genuine professional growth and an exceptional lifestyle, please send your resume and cover letter to nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

For a confidential discussion, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048

With more than 20 years’ experience recruiting medical specialists and consultants, Nicki provides confidential guidance and personalised support throughout the recruitment, registration and relocation process.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist – Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist – Emergency Medicine
Package Up to $647,306 | Coastal Lifestyle | Flexible Rostering
An exceptional opportunity is available for Emergency Medicine Specialists seeking an attractive remuneration package, genuine flexibility and a relaxed coastal lifestyle in one of Australia’s most naturally beautiful regions.

Permanent full-time and part-time appointments are available within a supportive Emergency Medicine service offering varied clinical exposure, excellent teaching opportunities and the freedom to develop your professional interests.

A Lifestyle Worth Relocating For
Imagine finishing your shift and being only minutes from uncrowded beaches, pristine wilderness, mountain-bike trails, fishing, kayaking and exceptional local food and produce.
The region offers affordable housing, short commutes, welcoming communities and the space to enjoy more time with family. Regional air and sea connections provide convenient access to mainland Australia, including direct flights to a major capital city in under an hour.

This is a rare opportunity to combine a rewarding specialist career with the lifestyle and flexibility many doctors spend years trying to achieve

The Opportunity
You will work within a well-established regional service operating across two Emergency Departments and supporting a population of approximately 116,000.
The departments collectively manage around 60,000 presentations annually, with the principal hospital serving as the regional trauma centre. Clinical services include:
  • Intensive care
  • General medicine and surgery
  • Orthopaedics
  • Paediatrics
  • Obstetrics and gynaecology
  • Mental health
  • Acute stroke telemedicine
  • 24-hour pathology and on-call radiology
Shape a Career Around Your Interests
You will join a small and inclusive specialist team with experience across toxicology, point-of-care ultrasound, paediatric emergency medicine, disaster and humanitarian medicine, clinical research, palliative care, medical education and administration.

Specialists are encouraged to develop individual portfolios aligned with their skills and interests while contributing to clinical governance, teaching, supervision and service development.
The department offers accredited Emergency Medicine training and provides opportunities to supervise ACEM, RACGP and ACRRM trainees and participate in education and outreach programs supporting more remote communities.

Remuneration and Benefits
  • Total remuneration package up to $647,306
  • 12% employer superannuation
  • 20% Regional Recruitment and Retention Allowance
  • 35% private practice scheme participation or allowance in lieu
  • Fully maintained private-plated vehicle or motor vehicle allowance of $28,786
  • Continuing Professional Development allowance of $17,483
  • Generous salary packaging benefits
  • Relocation and travel assistance
  • Study leave and professional development support
  • Comprehensive leave entitlements
  • Flexible full-time and part-time appointments
  • Exceptionally flexible rostering arrangements
Eligibility
Applications are welcomed from:
  • Fellows of the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine
  • Internationally trained Emergency Medicine Specialists who have completed an ACEM specialist assessment – substantially comparable ONLY.
How to Apply?
If you are an experienced Emergency Medicine Specialist seeking a rewarding position with genuine flexibility, outstanding professional opportunities and an exceptional coastal lifestyle, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

To express your interest, please select Apply Now and submit your current CV. For a confidential discussion or further information about the position, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

All applications and enquiries will be handled in the strictest confidence.

  • Open to experienced level 2 and 3 clinicians

job.description:

  • Locum rates + accommodation + travel

 
 
 
Experienced Occupational Therapist required for a vacancy based in regional Victoria. You will work alongside a small allied health team.
 
The Primary Care team comprises of a number of practitioners including: Dietetics, Occupational Therapist, Speech Pathologists, Physiotherapists, Health Promotion Officers, Exercise Physiologist, Social Workers, Nurse, Midwife, Allied Health Assistants, and Podiatry.  It is a predominately young and enthusiastic workforce. The staff provide services in the local area and outreach services to various small towns in the region. 


  • The caseload is across the spectrum from children through to the elderly and everything in between, including:
  • Paediatric clientele, Pre-NDIS clientele requiring support to access the NDIS, Community Aged Care – My Aged Care CHSP, HACC-PYP and HCP, Residential Aged Care, and Inpatient hospital – typically clientele who have been stepped down from the local Base Hospital.
  • There is a permanent Grade 2 role available also. Open to experienced Grade 1 clinicians looking to take a step up in their career.

I’ve had great feedback from my current locum! Minimum two years experience required.
 
FREE accommodation available + locum rates $$. 

Travel reimbursement also available.

Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super, more for ABN + option for living away from home tax benefits ($6/7 dollars per hour more).
 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise.
