job.title: Medical Oncology | Advanced Trainee / CMO / Senior Medical Practitioner
job.description:
Advanced Trainee / Career Medical Officer (CMO) / Senior Medical Practitioner (SMP) | Salary Package up to $220,000
Regional NSW - Outstanding Training | Award-Winning Research | No On-Call | Exceptional Work-Life Balance

Are you looking to advance your career in Medical Oncology within a highly regarded multidisciplinary cancer centre that combines outstanding clinical exposure, research excellence and an enviable lifestyle?
We are seeking an Advanced Trainee, Career Medical Officer (CMO) or Senior Medical Practitioner (SMP) to join a comprehensive regional cancer service based within a major 300-bed Rural Referral Hospital. Bringing together Medical Oncology, Haematology and Radiation Oncology under one roof, this modern service delivers exceptional patient care while providing outstanding opportunities for professional development.

Why Families Love Living Here
This thriving regional city offers everything you need for an exceptional quality of life. Families benefit from a wide choice of high-quality public, Catholic and independent schools, including selective academic programs, making it an excellent place to raise children. The city is also home to tertiary education options and strong pathways for ongoing learning.

Despite its regional setting, you'll enjoy excellent connectivity with multiple daily flights to Sydney, regular coach and rail services, and easy road access to major centres, making travel for work or visiting family simple and convenient. Public transport and school bus networks service the surrounding suburbs and regional communities, making commuting straightforward for families.

With short commute times and a welcoming community, you'll have more time to enjoy life outside the hospital.

The Opportunity
You'll become part of a collaborative and supportive oncology team comprising experienced Consultant Medical Oncologists, dedicated junior medical staff and specialist nursing teams. Working across outpatient and inpatient services, you'll gain broad experience in systemic therapies, multidisciplinary cancer management and complex oncology care.
This is an exceptional opportunity to work in a service that values education, mentorship and clinical excellence while maintaining an excellent work-life balance with no after-hours on-call commitment.

Why You'll Love This Role
  • Accredited Medical Oncology Advanced Training position
  • Four dedicated outpatient clinics each week
  • Comprehensive exposure to inpatient and outpatient oncology
  • Structured consultant supervision and formal teaching
  • Supervise and mentor junior medical staff
  • Regular multidisciplinary meetings and tumour streams with a leading tertiary cancer centre
  • Excellent work-life balance with no after-hours on-call
  • Supportive team culture focused on education and career progression
Research Opportunities
Be part of an award-winning clinical research unit actively involved in clinical trials and translational research. You'll be encouraged to:
  • Participate in clinical research projects
  • Present at oncology meetings
  • Publish and develop your academic portfolio
  • Work alongside experienced clinician researchers
The role also provides valuable experience delivering cancer care to rural and Indigenous communities, including exposure to innovative telehealth oncology services.
Spend less time commuting and more time doing what you enjoy, while remaining well connected to major metropolitan centres through regular flights.

Whether you're completing Advanced Training or looking to further your career as a Career Medical Officer or Senior Medical Practitioner, this is an opportunity to join a highly respected oncology service committed to clinical excellence, research and professional development.

How to Apply
 If you're ready to take the next step in your Medical Oncology career, we'd love to hear from you.
For a confidential discussion or to learn more about this opportunity, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
0401 010 048
nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Staff Specialist Radiation Oncology
job.description:
Staff Specialist – Radiation Oncology
Deliver world-class cancer care while enjoying the lifestyle you've worked hard for.
Are you a Radiation Oncologist looking for a role where clinical excellence, collaboration and quality of life go hand in hand?

We're recruiting for a permanent Specialist opportunity within a highly respected tertiary Radiation Oncology service that delivers the full spectrum of contemporary cancer care. You'll join a collegial, forward-thinking team where your expertise is genuinely valued, your ideas are welcomed, and your contribution has a lasting impact on patients and the service.

More Than Just a Job
Imagine finishing work and being minutes from spectacular coastlines, mountain trails, award-winning restaurants and vibrant arts and cultural events. Enjoy short commutes, affordable living, excellent schools and a welcoming community that makes it easy to build a fulfilling life both professionally and personally.

If you're looking for a consultant role where you can practise high-quality medicine without sacrificing your lifestyle, we'd love to speak with you.
This is an exceptional opportunity to combine a rewarding consultant career with an enviable work-life balance, offering more time for family, outdoor pursuits and the things that matter most.

Why consider this opportunity?
  • Permanent consultant position with an attractive remuneration package of up to $450,000+
  • Work across a broad and diverse oncology case mix with modern technology and contemporary treatment techniques
  • Join a supportive multidisciplinary team committed to delivering outstanding patient-centred care
  • Opportunities to develop subspecialty interests and contribute to service innovation
  • Strong links with a leading university, providing teaching, mentoring and research opportunities
  • Dedicated professional development leave and generous CPD allowance
  • Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance available for international specialists
The Role
As a Staff Specialist, you will:
  • Provide consultant-level radiation oncology services across inpatient and outpatient settings
  • Participate in multidisciplinary cancer meetings and collaborative treatment planning
  • Supervise and mentor junior doctors and trainees
  • Contribute to undergraduate and postgraduate education
  • Participate in clinical research, quality improvement and service development initiatives
What we're looking for
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists (RANZCR), or an equivalent recognised specialist qualification
  • Eligibility for Specialist Registration with the Medical Board of Australia (AHPRA)
  • A collaborative, patient-focused approach to clinical care
  • An interest in teaching, research and continuous service improvement
Interested?
If you're looking to join a progressive Radiation Oncology service where you can make a meaningful difference while enjoying an exceptional lifestyle, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Nicki Wade for a confidential discussion.
0401 010 048
nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

Not quite the right opportunity? Feel free to get in touch to discuss other Radiation Oncology positions available across Australia, or share this opportunity with a colleague who may be interested.

job.title: Specialist Obstetricians & Gynaecologists | Regional Australia
job.description:
Specialist Obstetricians & Gynaecologists | Regional Australia
Multiple Permanent Opportunities Across South Australia, Queensland, Tasmania and the Northern Territory/NSW
Salary packages from $380k -$600k PLUS
Are you a Specialist Obstetrician and Gynaecologist looking for a rewarding career move, greater professional autonomy and a better work-life balance?
I am recruiting for several permanent Consultant/Specialist Obstetrician and Gynaecologist opportunities across regional South Australia, Queensland, Tasmania and the Northern Territory/NSW.

Why Consider Regional Australia?
Imagine building a rewarding specialist career while living somewhere your commute is measured in minutes rather than hours.
Depending on the location, you could enjoy:
  • Tropical beaches, islands and year-round outdoor living
  • Spectacular coastlines, national parks and mountain ranges
  • Fishing, boating, hiking, cycling and camping
  • Award-winning wineries and outstanding local produce
  • Affordable housing and a significantly lower cost of living
  • Excellent schools and welcoming, family-friendly communities
  • Short commutes and more time for family, travel and recreation
  • The opportunity to become a trusted and valued member of the community
Regional practice also offers a broad and varied clinical caseload, greater professional autonomy and the opportunity to influence how women’s health services are developed and delivered.
These roles offer the chance to deliver comprehensive women’s health services while joining supportive multidisciplinary teams and making a genuine difference to regional communities.

The Opportunities
Depending on the location and your clinical interests, positions may include:
  • General obstetrics and gynaecology
  • Antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care
  • Emergency and elective gynaecological services
  • Outpatient clinics and procedural work
  • Participation in a shared on-call roster
  • Clinical leadership and service development
  • Teaching and supervision of junior doctors and trainees
  • Quality improvement, clinical governance and research
Full-time and part-time opportunities may be considered, with attractive remuneration packages and flexible working arrangements available across selected locations.

What’s on Offer?
Packages vary between locations and may include:
  • Highly competitive consultant remuneration
  • Employer superannuation contributions
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Professional development allowances and leave
  • Relocation assistance
  • Visa sponsorship for eligible international specialists
  • Flexible full-time or part-time arrangements
  • Private practice opportunities in selected locations
  • Support with medical registration and specialist pathway requirements
About You
You will hold:
  • MBBS or an equivalent primary medical qualification
  • Fellowship of RANZCOG or an equivalent recognised specialist qualification
  • Specialist Registration with the Medical Board of Australia, or eligibility to obtain registration
  • Strong clinical, communication and multidisciplinary teamwork skills
  • A commitment to high-quality, patient-centred women’s healthcare
Internationally trained Obstetricians and Gynaecologists who are assessed as substantially comparable or Expedited Specialist Pathway are encouraged to enquire.
Whether you are looking for coastal living, a tropical lifestyle, a close-knit regional community or the opportunity to take on greater clinical leadership, I would be pleased to discuss the locations and positions that best match your experience, career goals and lifestyle preferences.

For a confidential discussion about current Specialist Obstetrics and Gynaecology roles across regional Australia, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
0401 010 048
nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Consultant C&A Psychiatrist
job.description:
What’s on offer 
  • $400,000 - $550,000 p.a. + relocation allowance
  • Large tertiary service with experienced multidisciplinary teams
  • 40-hour working week - ideal for work-life balance
  • Career growth opportunities, supportive workplace culture
  • Excellent employee benefits
  • Relaxed sub-tropical lifestyle with year-round sunshine
  • Easy access to the Great Barrier Reef and Magnetic Island
About the role
 
This position is based in a large tertiary referral hospital in North Queensland, serving a catchment of approximately 700,000 people. As the region's principal referral centre, the hospital provides a broad range of specialist services and has strong links with James Cook University, supporting research, education, and clinical excellence.

The Mental Health Service delivers recovery-focused care to children and adolescents across inpatient and community settings, providing assessment, treatment, and ongoing management for a wide range of severe and complex mental health conditions.

As a Consultant Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist, you will provide specialist psychiatric care within a multidisciplinary team across the Acute Inpatient Unit and community services. Melbourne, Victoria | Full-Time or Part-Time

Are you a Consultant Psychiatrist looking for more than just your next clinical role?
This is a unique opportunity to join the newly established Parkville Youth Mental Health & Wellbeing Service (PYMHWS) and play a leading role in developing Australia's first statewide early intervention forensic youth mental health service.

Working across Cherry Creek Youth Justice Precinct, Parkville and Malmsbury, you'll care for young people aged 12–25 years with complex mental health, neurodevelopmental and trauma-related presentations, while helping to transform how forensic youth mental healthcare is delivered across Victoria.

The Role
As a Consultant Psychiatrist within the Forensic Youth Mental Health Service (FYMHS), you will:
  • Provide specialist psychiatric assessment and treatment for young people in custodial settings.
  • Lead and support an experienced multidisciplinary team.
  • Provide clinical oversight for dedicated mental health units within Cherry Creek Youth Justice Precinct.
  • Supervise Psychiatry Registrars and junior medical staff.
  • Influence statewide service development, innovation and clinical governance.
  • Work collaboratively with Youth Justice, health, education and community services to improve outcomes for vulnerable young people.
This is an outstanding opportunity for psychiatrists with experience or an interest in Forensic Psychiatry, Child & Adolescent Psychiatry, Youth Mental Health, or General Adult Psychiatry looking to broaden their scope into forensic youth services.

What We're Looking For
  • FRANZCP (or substantially comparable international specialist qualifications eligible for specialist registration)
  • Experience working with young people experiencing complex mental illness
  • Interest or experience in forensic mental health or youth justice
  • Strong leadership, supervision and multidisciplinary team skills
  • Passion for service development, education and improving systems of care
Why This Opportunity?
  • Help build a brand-new statewide service from the ground up
  • Influence clinical practice and service design
  • Work with highly complex, rewarding and meaningful cases
  • Excellent opportunities for leadership, teaching and research
  • Flexible full-time or part-time appointments
  • Attractive remuneration and salary packaging benefits
  • Join an organisation committed to innovation, staff wellbeing and professional development
Why Melbourne?
Melbourne offers an exceptional lifestyle with world-class healthcare, outstanding schools, vibrant arts and dining, beautiful parks and easy access to beaches, wineries and regional Victoria. It's the ideal destination for psychiatrists seeking both career progression and an outstanding quality of life.

How to Apply

Working amongst the multidisciplinary team which is young and dynamic. The team regularly plan weekend adventures including camping, rodeos, and local events like wine festivals, balls, markets, and sporting events. We even hold an Allied Health Ball every year to celebrate all Allied Health Clinicians in North West Queensland. We have a few gyms in town including a yoga studio, Anytime Fitness, Pilates studio, a public pool and plenty of outdoor walking areas. There are cafes, a library, Kmart, Woolies and Coles, Harvey Norman, and a couple of specialty stores. The area is surrounded by cattle stations and you can even feed some camels just down the road from the Hospital! There’s a large freshwater lake 10km out of town where people regularly paddleboard, water ski, swim, and kayak to get their water fix, and there’s lots of water holes/water falls that can be visited after wet season to keep cool.


There are daily flights to Brisbane and Townsville and some direct flights throughout the week to Cairns.

The rural and remote lifestyle often has some surprising perks and the opportunities both professionally and personally are great.
  • If you trained overseas, you must have been assessed by the AASW BEFORE you contact me.
  • Hospital experience is essential, candidates without recent hospital experience will not be considered.

The service is a voluntary service assisting clients within Tennant Creek Hospital, Tennant Creek Community and outlying remote communities within the Barkly Region. You will work Monday to Friday standard office hours. No On Call.
  • Return travel reimbursed up to $1300 and accommodation provided

job.title: Clinical Director of Orthopaedics
job.description:
Clinical Director of Orthopaedics | Lead One of Queensland's Major Regional Surgical Services
Up to $529K+ Package

Are you an experienced Consultant/Specialist Orthopaedic Surgeon looking to take the next step into clinical leadership without giving up the operating theatre?
We are seeking to recruit an outstanding Clinical Director of Orthopaedics to lead a highly regarded regional referral service while maintaining an active surgical practice.
This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of orthopaedic services, influence strategic direction, mentor the next generation of surgeons, and continue delivering high-quality elective and trauma care.

Location?
A major referral centre, offering an exceptional lifestyle without compromising your career.
Enjoy:
  • Affordable housing and excellent schools
  • Short commute and outstanding work-life balance
  • Direct flights to Brisbane
  • Fishing, boating, hiking and outdoor adventures on your doorstep
  • A welcoming, family-friendly community
Why consider this opportunity?
As Clinical Director, you'll provide strategic and operational leadership to a busy, well-established Orthopaedic Department while maintaining a minimum 0.5 FTE clinical workload.
You'll join a collaborative surgical team within a modern referral hospital offering:
  • Four operating theatres and two procedure rooms
  • Six-bed Intensive Care Unit
  • Diverse elective and trauma caseload
  • Accredited specialist training program
  • Strong culture of teaching, research and quality improvement
  • Excellent multidisciplinary support
This role offers genuine autonomy and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on orthopaedic services across the region.

Attractive Remuneration
Total remuneration of up to $529,000+ per annum, including:
  • Competitive specialist salary
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • Professional Development Leave (3.6 weeks)
  • Professional Development Allowance of $22,145 per annum
  • Clinical Manager Allowance
  • Motor Vehicle Allowance
  • On-call and overtime payments
  • Attraction and Retention Incentives
  • Salary packaging options
  • Paid parental leave
About You
You will be:
  • FRACS (Orthopaedic Surgery) qualified, or eligible for specialist registration in Australia
  • An experienced Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon with demonstrated leadership capability
  • Passionate about clinical excellence, mentoring and developing surgical services
  • Committed to education, research and continuous quality improvement
Whether you're already leading a department or looking to transition into your first Clinical Director role, we'd love to speak with you.

How to Apply
If you're ready to take the next step in your career and lead a high-performing Orthopaedic service, please send your CV and cover letter to Nicki Wade, Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors, at nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.
For a confidential discussion about the role, please call +61 401 010 048.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Geriatrician
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Geriatrician | Victoria, Australia – Salary package up to $440k
Coastal Lifestyle. Academic Opportunities. Shape the Future of Regional Geriatric Care.

Are you a Consultant/Specialist Geriatrician looking for a role that combines clinical variety, genuine work-life balance and the opportunity to make a lasting impact?

We are seeking an enthusiastic Consultant Geriatrician to join its growing multidisciplinary team in a beautiful coastal city, one of Victoria's most desirable regional locations.

Why?
Imagine finishing your clinic and being on the beach within minutes.
Located on Victoria's spectacular Great South Coast, it offers an exceptional lifestyle that is increasingly difficult to find in metropolitan centres.
Enjoy:
  • Beautiful beaches and coastal walking trails
  • Whale watching during migration season
  • World-famous Great Ocean Road nearby
  • Outstanding cafes, restaurants and wineries
  • Affordable housing compared with Australia's major cities
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Short flights to Melbourne or an easy scenic drive
It is the perfect location for doctors seeking a rewarding consultant career without sacrificing family life or personal wellbeing.

The role
This is far more than a traditional inpatient geriatric medicine position. You'll become part of an innovative service that spans:
  • Acute inpatient Geriatric Medicine
  • GEM (Geriatric Evaluation & Management)
  • GEM@Home program
  • Cognitive Dementia and Memory Service (CDAMS)
  • Specialist Falls & Balance Clinic
  • The opportunity to establish and develop additional subspecialty outpatient clinics aligned with your interests
  • For clinicians who enjoy building services and influencing models of care, this position offers genuine autonomy and professional satisfaction.

Academic & Research Opportunities
It is closely affiliated with Deakin University Clinical School, providing opportunities to:
  • Teach and mentor medical students and junior doctors
  • Participate in clinical research and quality improvement
  • Contribute to the development of future geriatric medicine services
If you enjoy combining clinical medicine with education or research, this is an outstanding environment to continue developing your career.

Attractive Benefits
  • Competitive consultant remuneration
  • Up to $9,010 salary packaging
  • Relocation assistance (where applicable)
  • Additional superannuation opportunities
  • Strong professional development support
  • Leadership and mentoring programs
  • Excellent multidisciplinary support
  • Permanent full-time appointment
If you've been considering a move to Australia or are already in Australia looking for a consultant role offering greater lifestyle and career satisfaction would love to have a confidential discussion.

Shape your consultant career at one of New South Wales' leading tertiary hospitals.

job.title: Locum Social Worker/Occupational Therapist/Podiatrist
job.description:
• ASAP start for 8-12 weeks + possible extension
  • Rural Generalist inc outpatients, community and outreach
  • Locum rates + FREE accommodation available

 
Experienced clinicians required for locum based in regional Victoria. The role is to start ASAP start for 8-12 weeks + possible extension.
 
Social Worker

Mental Health experience is desirable, as well as experience working with CALD and indigenous communities and experience in rural health. The mental health team currently has one Mental Health Nurse and one other Social Worker. You will join a team of approximately 20 Health Staff including Nurses, Midwife, Speech Pathology, Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Health Promotion, Allied Health Assistants, Podiatrists & Dietitians.
 
This generalist caseload will cover:
Predominately working with outpatients/community members.  Age ranges from young children to aged.  The team work in the local schools, the local Aboriginal Health Service and in the community.  They have a mental health drop-in clinic 3 mornings a week as well.  They work with the Hospital Outreach Mental Health team as well as other community organisations.  Cases include general counselling to more complex mental health issues, through to assisting people negotiate Medicare, visas, government departments, housing etc. 
 
 

Occupational Therapist

The Primary Care team comprises of a number of practitioners including: Dietetics, Occupational Therapist, Speech Pathologists, Physiotherapists, Health Promotion Officers, Exercise Physiologist, Social Workers, Nurse, Midwife, Allied Health Assistants, and Podiatry.  It is a predominately young and enthusiastic workforce. The staff provide services in the local area and outreach services to various small towns in the region. 

The caseload is across the spectrum from children through to the elderly and everything in between, including:
  • Paediatric clientele, Pre-NDIS clientele requiring support to access the NDIS, Community Aged Care – My Aged Care CHSP, HACC-PYP and HCP, Residential Aged Care, and Inpatient hospital – typically clientele who have been stepped down from the local Base Hospital.
  • There is a permanent Grade 2 role available also. Open to experienced Grade 1 clinicians looking to take a step up in their career.

 
 
Podiatrist
  • A mixed caseload of clients from 0-100 years
  • Working across outpatients, community, a small amount of aged care & outreach
  • You will work alongside a team of other allied health professionals on the team including OT, Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Speech Pathologists, Dietitian, Qualified Social Worker, Health Promotion Officer and Allied Health Assistants
 
 
FREE accommodation available + locum rates $$. I’ve had great feedback from previous locums!

Travel reimbursement also available.

Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super, up to $100 for ABN + option for PAYG living away from home tax benefits ($6/7 dollars per hour more).
 
 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

job.title: Consultant Anaesthetists | Multiple Opportunities Across Victoria
job.description:
Consultant Anaesthetists | Multiple Opportunities Across Victoria
Coastal | Regional | Metropolitan | Up to $450K+ Packages | Visa Sponsorship Available
Looking for more than just your next job?

Imagine practising high-quality anaesthesia in a supportive department while enjoying everything Victoria has to offer from world-famous coastlines and award-winning wineries to vibrant regional cities, national parks and easy access to Melbourne.

We are seeking to recruit Consultant Anaesthetists for permanent full-time, part-time and sessional appointments.
Whether you're seeking a busy regional referral centre, a lifestyle-focused coastal location or a growing regional hospital with genuine work-life balance, we have opportunities to suit every stage of your career.

Current Opportunities Include
Major regional referral centre with excellent opportunities in perioperative medicine, ICU, pain management and medical education while enjoying one of Australia's most spectacular coastlines.
Large tertiary regional health service offering diverse and complex anaesthetic practice within a rapidly expanding organisation.

Flexible consultant and sessional appointments providing broad clinical exposure with easy access to the Grampians National Park, Ballarat and Melbourne.
Join a supportive multidisciplinary team delivering anaesthesia across a broad range of specialties while enjoying the Lakes, 90 Mile Beach and an outstanding regional lifestyle.
Additional opportunities are also available throughout regional Victoria.

What You'll Be Doing
As a Consultant Anaesthetist, you will:
  • Deliver high-quality anaesthetic and perioperative care
  • Provide services across a wide range of surgical specialties
  • Participate in perioperative medicine and clinical governance
  • Supervise and mentor junior medical staff
  • Contribute to education, teaching and quality improvement initiatives
  • Participate in on-call rosters appropriate to your appointment
Many roles offer opportunities to develop subspecialty interests including:
  • Obstetric Anaesthesia
  • Regional Anaesthesia
  • Perioperative Medicine
  • Intensive Care
  • Acute and Chronic Pain
  • Medical Education
  • Quality Improvement
  • Research
What's on Offer
  • Permanent, Fixed-Term, Part-Time and Sessional appointments
  • Competitive remuneration with packages reaching $450,000+ depending on location, seniority and on-call arrangements
  • Salary packaging and generous leave entitlements
  • Relocation assistance
  • Professional development and study leave
  • Supportive multidisciplinary teams
  • Teaching opportunities with leading universities
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Outstanding lifestyle and affordable housing
International Specialists Encouraged to Apply
We welcome enquiries from overseas-trained Anaesthetists who hold comparable specialist qualifications.
We have extensive experience assisting international doctors with:
  • AHPRA Specialist Registration
  • Expedited Specialist Pathway (where eligible)
  • ANZCA Specialist Assessment
  • Visa sponsorship (including 482)
  • Relocation support
About You
To be considered you will have:
  • Fellowship of ANZCA or an equivalent recognised specialist qualification
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA, or eligibility to obtain registration
  • Excellent clinical and communication skills
  • A commitment to patient-centred care and multidisciplinary teamwork
  • An interest in teaching, quality improvement and service development
Why Victoria?
Victoria combines outstanding career opportunities with one of Australia's most desirable lifestyles.
Enjoy beautiful coastlines, national parks, vibrant regional cities, excellent schools, award-winning food and wine, and easy access to Melbourne all while working in modern health services committed to clinical excellence and professional development.

Interested?
If you're considering your next Consultant Anaesthetist opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.
Whether you're relocating from interstate or overseas, we'll help guide you through every step of the process from registration and visas through to relocation and settling into your new community.

For a confidential discussion or to apply, please send your resume and cover letter to:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
+61 401 010 048
nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Psychiatry Registrar | RANZCP Accredited Training
job.description:
Psychiatry Registrar | RANZCP Accredited Training - VIC
Join One of Victoria's Leading Regional Mental Health Training Programs

Looking to advance your Psychiatry career in a supportive, accredited training environment?
Our client is offering exciting opportunities for Psychiatry Registrars (Basic & Advanced Training) to join its well-established Mental Health & Wellbeing Service.
This is an exceptional opportunity to gain broad clinical experience across multiple psychiatry subspecialties while completing RANZCP-accredited training with outstanding consultant supervision and a structured education program.

Location
Located only two hours from Melbourne, it offers:
  • Affordable housing
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Fantastic lifestyle and outdoor recreation
  • Thriving cafés, wineries and restaurants
  • Easy access to Melbourne
  • A welcoming multicultural community
Why?
  • RANZCP Accredited Basic & Advanced Psychiatry Training
  • Comprehensive rotations across multiple psychiatry subspecialties
  • Dedicated consultant supervision and mentorship
  • Weekly protected teaching and exam preparation
  • Psychotherapy supervision and Balint groups
  • Affiliation with the University of Melbourne Rural Clinical School
  • Strong research and teaching opportunities
  • Supportive multidisciplinary team environment
  • Excellent work-life balance in regional Victoria
Diverse Clinical Exposure
Develop your skills across a broad range of services including:
  • Adult Psychiatry
  • Acute Inpatient Psychiatry
  • Community Mental Health
  • Consultation Liaison Psychiatry
  • Older Persons Psychiatry
  • Child & Adolescent Mental Health
  • Addiction Psychiatry
  • Early Psychosis Services
  • Women's Recovery Network
  • Residential Rehabilitation
  • Prevention & Recovery Care (PARC)
  • Private Psychiatry (Ramsay Clinic)
  • Mental Health Triage
About the Role
As a Psychiatry Registrar, you will:
  • Conduct psychiatric assessments and formulate management plans
  • Diagnose and manage acute and chronic mental illness
  • Work within multidisciplinary teams delivering high-quality patient care
  • Participate in inpatient, outpatient and community services
  • Complete Mental Health Act documentation and Tribunal requirements
  • Participate in an on-call roster
  • Supervise junior medical staff where appropriate
  • Utilise telehealth to support regional mental health care
Enjoy the perfect balance between career progression and lifestyle.

Essential Requirements
Applicants should have:
  • Current or eligible AHPRA registration
  • Eligibility for RANZCP training
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Commitment to high-quality patient-centred care
International Medical Graduates who meet AHPRA registration requirements are encouraged to apply.

Ready to Take the Next Step?
If you're looking for an accredited Psychiatry Registrar position offering excellent supervision, diverse clinical exposure and outstanding training opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now
To apply for this opportunity, please submit your CV and cover letter to Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant, at nickiw@ccjobs.com.au or contact +61 401 010 048 for a confidential chat.

Experienced Hospital Pharmacists required for urgent locums in Darwin.  This is an acute hospital. The caseload will cover ward based across medical, surgical, renal, cardiology. You must be confident working across the wards.
 
Further details:
  • Hours/days per week – 5 days per week, 7.21 hours per day (36.45 hours/week)
  • The work will span dispensary, discharge and admissions teams. Inpatients across all areas of the hospital, including medical, surgical, renal, cardiology.
  • Join a team of 30 pharmacists
  • Accommodation is onsite and is charged at a cost of $155 per week (first 2 weeks waived)
  • Return travel allowance is up to $600 (with receipts)
  • Locum rates + option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay! Option for ABN
  • You must have AHPRA registration and Australian hospital pharmacy experience
 
The Northern Territory is a multi-cultural region with lots to offer including great markets, restaurants, nightlife and natural beauty. Explore the iconic Kakadu and Litchfield National Park, as well as the Tiwi Islands and enjoy cheap flights to Bali.
 
 
 
 

URGENT Regional VIC city - Locum Hospital Pharmacists required - several vacancies
  • July start date for 8-12 weeks
  • Ward and dispensary based
  • FREE accommodation available 
  • One way domestic travel reimbursed
  • Locum rates + option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay! Option for ABN
 
 
 
 
URGENT NW TAS - Locum Hospital Pharmacist required
  • July start for up to three months
  • Accommodation assistance
  • Ward or dispensary
New locum role available in North West Tasmania. The roles are to start ASAP for up to three months. You will be either ward or dispensary based.
 
You will work as a part of the relevant Hospital’s Pharmacy Department and Hospital’s Pharmacy Team to provide a comprehensive, efficient and accountable pharmacy service for hospital inpatients and outpatients.
 
You will have:
  • Pharmacy experience in a range of activities such as dispensing or clinical pharmacy, preferably in a hospital setting, together with experience in the application of relevant legislation, codes of practice and workplace guidelines in the practice of pharmacy.
  •  An understanding of (and preferably experience with) the frameworks used to guide and develop clinical pharmacy services, such as the APAC Guidelines, Pharmaceutical Review, and Medication Management Review programs (e.g., HMR and DMMR).
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of the application of the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme.
  • Knowledge of aseptic manufacturing techniques.
  • Ability to assess and evaluate drug regimens and medicines information and provide tailored advice to other healthcare professionals and the patient.
  • Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to contribute effectively as an active member of a diverse, multidisciplinary team.
  • History of contributing positively to the workplace and delivering workplace improvements within a continuous quality improvement framework.
  • Demonstrated problem solving and conflict resolution skills applied to resolve practice-based issues.
Locum rates dependent on experience with accommodation assistance. There is an airport in this town.
 
  • Option for ABN - increased hourly rate!
  • Option for PAYG + living away from home tax benefits - more take home pay!

Hospital Pharmacist required for urgent locums in Wide Bay, Queensland. This is an acute hospital. The caseload will cover ward based across gen med/surg/orthopaedics. You must be confident working across the ward. The requirements are as follows:
 
Further details:
  • The service use IPharmacy
  • Upto $72 per hour + super depending on experience, more for ABN
  • Option for living away from home tax benefits
  • Accommodation provided
  • Upto $250 each way reimbursed for travel

  • You must have AHPRA registration and Australian hospital pharmacy experience
  • Great feedback from current locums!
This location is a tourist hotspot, famed for whale watching, water sports, iconic beaches and islands. It’s within driving distance of Brisbane and the Sunshine Coast. I’ve placed many locums with this service and the feedback is excellent.
 
  • Option for ABN - increased hourly rate!
  • Option for PAYG + living away from home tax benefits - more take home pay!
 
 
 
 
NT – Locum Hospital Pharmacist
  • 8 week locum ++
  • Accommodation & travel assistance
  • Clinical wards or dispensary based
Experienced Pharmacist required for hospital based role in the Northern Territory. You will join team of 60 allied health clinicians, including other Pharmacists, Occupational Therapists, Podiatrists, Physiotherapists, Speech Pathologists, Dietitians, Social Worker, Chaplain, ALO. I’ve had great feedback from my current allied health locums.

Join this large allied health team, including some of my other locums. All have extended their time with this hospital. The team are inclusive and social. There is support and supervision available.


85% of the caseload is indigenous, with 50% coming in from remote communities. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums and this is a great chance to develop your skill set. If you like the outdoors, the lifestyle here is fab!

It’s also a fascinating spot to explore Australia’s Aboriginal culture.
 
 
  • Option for ABN - increased hourly rate!

They work on a transdisciplinary model so generally two disciplines work together and travel together (eg SP and OT, OT and PT etc). Some adults but prioritising paeds. There is a paediatric inpatients and paediatric feeding/swallowing outpatient service however, this caseload is negotiable and not essential to the locum role.
 
There will also be a requirement to cover the hospital acute Speech Pathology role during periods of leave/shortages.
 
  • The role involves occasional travelling to remote communities in the Big Rivers region by 4WD or light aircraft, staying overnight during weekdays.
  • Join a team of 2 OTs, 1 Physio, 2 Public Health Dietitians, 1 Allied Health Assistant, 1 Team Leader
  • ASAP start for 8-12 weeks
  • Return travel reimbursed (upto $1200) and free accommodation for locums.
  • Great feedback from my current locums!
  • Supportive and social team
  • Enjoy weekends out in nature - enjoy gorges, waterfalls, camping and hikes!
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super + option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay!
Great feedback from my current locums!

Come to where the Outback meets the tropics and discover a region full of gorges and misty waterfalls, thermal springs and ancient cultures. This region is a nature lovers paradise.

job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Psychiatrist – Forensic Mental Health
Melbourne, Victoria | Full-Time, Fractional & Sessional Opportunities | Visa Sponsorship Available
Looking for a psychiatry role that offers genuine work-life balance, academic opportunities, and a chance to make a meaningful impact?
  • Psychiatrists assessed as Substantially Comparable, on the Expedited Specialist Pathway (psychiatrists holding a UK CCT or Irish CSCST), or eligible for RANZCP assessment are encouraged to apply.
We are currently seeking Consultant Psychiatrists to join one of Australia's most respected forensic mental health services.
Opportunities are available across both Community and Prison Services, offering flexibility, professional growth, and the chance to work alongside leading experts in forensic psychiatry.
Whether you are an experienced forensic psychiatrist or a general adult psychiatrist interested in expanding your expertise, this role offers exceptional support and career development within a highly regarded statewide service.

Melbourne
Consistently ranked among the world's most liveable cities, Melbourne offers:
  • Excellent schools and universities
  • Vibrant dining and cultural scene
  • International airport with direct global connections
  • Easy access to beaches, wineries, mountains and regional Victoria
If you're looking for a rewarding Consultant Psychiatrist opportunity offering flexibility, career development and an exceptional lifestyle, we'd love to speak with you.

Why This Opportunity?
  • Monday to Friday role with no routine weekend work
  • Flexible full-time, part-time and sessional appointments
  • Supportive multidisciplinary teams
  • Research, teaching and academic opportunities
  •  Clear career progression pathways
  • Strong focus on staff wellbeing and professional development
  • Work within a nationally and internationally recognised forensic mental health service
About the Service
With a reputation for excellence in clinical care, education, research and innovation, it delivers specialist services across prisons, courts, secure hospitals and community settings. You will join a highly respected organisation at the forefront of forensic mental health practice in Australia.

The Role
You will provide specialist psychiatric assessment, treatment and ongoing management for patients within forensic mental health settings while working collaboratively within experienced multidisciplinary teams.
Additional opportunities include:
  • Supervision and teaching of trainees and junior doctors
  • Research and academic development
  • Service improvement and leadership initiatives
  • Participation in innovative models of forensic mental health care
Previous forensic psychiatry experience is highly regarded but not essential.

International Psychiatrists Encouraged to Apply
We welcome applications from overseas-trained psychiatrists.
Support includes:
  • Employer sponsorship available (482 or 186 Visa)
  • Relocation assistance of up to $10,000
  • Support navigating the RANZCP Specialist Pathway
  • Assistance with relocation to Australia
Benefits
  • Attractive specialist remuneration package
  • Salary packaging options available
  • Employee wellbeing and assistance programs
  • Peer support and psychological wellbeing services
  • Professional development support
  • Research and teaching opportunities
Essential Requirements
  • FRANZCP or equivalent specialist psychiatry qualification
  • Eligibility for specialist or limited specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Strong clinical and communication skills
  • Commitment to multidisciplinary and patient-centred care
How to Apply:

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Emergency Physician
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Emergency Physician
University Hospital | Tropical North Queensland | Salary Package up to $500k plus
Join one of Australia's busiest and most dynamic Emergency Departments and enjoy a rewarding specialist career in tropical Queensland.

Why?
This regional city offers an enviable lifestyle combining a vibrant coastal city with access to some of Australia's most spectacular natural attractions.
Enjoy:
  • Tropical climate with over 300 days of sunshine annually
  • Affordable housing and excellent schools
  • Direct flights to Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne
  • Easy access to the Great Barrier Reef and Magnetic Island
  • Outstanding fishing, diving, boating and outdoor recreation
  • Strong university and research links through James Cook University

The Opportunity
An exciting opportunity exists for a Consultant Emergency Physician to join the Emergency Department at a University Hospital, a major tertiary referral centre.
Managing approximately 100,000 presentations annually, the department provides a broad and highly rewarding scope of practice across adult and paediatric emergency medicine, trauma, retrieval medicine and critical care.

This is a rare opportunity to work within a large tertiary service while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of regional Queensland.

About the Emergency Department
The department is one of the largest and busiest Emergency Departments in Queensland and provides care for patients across a vast geographic region.
Key features include:
  • Approximately 100,000 presentations per annum
  • Dedicated 12-bed Paediatric Emergency Department
  • Around 20% paediatric presentations
  • Overall admission rate of approximately 30%
  • Excellent patient flow with 95% ambulance off-stretcher performance
  • Adult and paediatric Emergency Medicine exposure
  • Emergency Short Stay Unit
  • Aeromedical Retrieval Clinical Coordination for North Queensland
  • Participation in the innovative Frailty Intervention Team
  • Major trauma and tertiary referral services
  • Strong culture of education, research and clinical governance
Leadership & Teaching
This position offers significant involvement in supervision, mentorship and workforce development.
You will work closely with and provide teaching and supervision to:
  • 16 FTE Interns
  • 40 FTE Resident Medical Officers
  • 33 FTE Emergency Medicine Registrars
  • 3 FTE Physician Assistants
The role provides an excellent platform for consultants interested in medical education, leadership, quality improvement and service development.

Benefits
  • 12.75% Employer Superannuation
  • 4–6 weeks annual leave
  • 14%–17.5% leave loading
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Relocation assistance available for eligible candidates
Requirements
  • Fellowship of the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine (FACEM) or equivalent, IMG’s assessed as substantially comparable will also be considered
  • Eligibility for Specialist Registration with the Medical Board of Australia
  • Experience in both adult and paediatric emergency medicine
The location offers the perfect balance between career opportunity and lifestyle.

Enjoy:
  • Affordable coastal living
  • Excellent schools and family amenities
  • Short commutes and relaxed regional lifestyle
  • Easy access to beaches, national parks, fishing, diving, and boating
  • Direct daily flights
To be considered
Send your CV and cover letter to: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
or call +61 401 010 048

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant

job.title: Senior Specialist / Specialist / Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Senior Specialist / Specialist / Emergency Medicine
Lead. Teach. Innovate. Live Exceptionally. Coastal Queensland
These roles tend to attract significant interest it offers the rare combination of meaningful Emergency Medicine, genuine departmental support, and an outstanding lifestyle by the coast.
Please share with any colleagues considering a coastal move.
  • Exceptional Remuneration Package value up to $627,119 p.a.
  • IMGs assessed by ACEM with substantial comparability will be considered
An exciting opportunity exists for experienced Emergency Medicine Consultants/Specialists to join the Department of Emergency Medicine at one of Queensland’s fastest-growing regional referral hospitals.

Coastal Lifestyle Without Metro Stress
One of Australia’s most attractive regional lifestyles.
  • Beautiful beaches, oceanfront living, and year-round sunshine
  • Affordable housing and significantly lower living costs than metropolitan cities
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Modern cafes, restaurants, wineries, and local produce
  • Easy access to Brisbane with direct flights available
  • Family-friendly communities with less traffic and more time for life outside work
  • Fishing, boating, diving, camping, surfing, and national parks right on your doorstep
  • Outstanding local produce, cafés and restaurants
This is a location where Emergency Physicians can build a sustainable long-term career while enjoying genuine lifestyle balance for themselves and their families.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Specialist / Specialist within the Emergency Department, you will provide expert emergency clinical care while contributing to the ongoing development of a modern regional emergency service.
You will join a collaborative multidisciplinary team delivering high-quality emergency care to a large and diverse population across the Wide Bay region.

Position Details
  • Permanent Full Time
  • Permanent Part Time
  • Flexible rostering arrangements negotiable
Why This Role Stands Out
Exceptional Remuneration Package
Total remuneration package value up to $627,119 p.a., including:
  • Base salary up to $274,678 p.a.
  • Emergency Department Allowance
  • Attraction Incentive Allowance (50%)
  • Regional Location Allowance (10%)
  • Motor Vehicle Allowance
  • Professional Development Allowance
  • Generous employer superannuation contribution of up to 12.75%
  • Salary sacrificing benefits
  • Annual Leave Loading (17.5%)
Modern Regional Emergency Medicine
The hospital continues to expand as a major regional referral centre, providing clinicians with:
  • broad and rewarding clinical exposure
  • regional autonomy
  • excellent procedural opportunities
  • strong multidisciplinary support
  • meaningful involvement in service improvement
Clinical Exposure Includes
  • Adult and paediatric emergency medicine
  • Trauma and resuscitation
  • Acute regional presentations
  • Complex chronic disease management
  • Clinical Decision Unit management
  • Rural and regional referral medicine
  • Mental health and behavioural emergencies
  • High-acuity emergency presentations
Leadership, Teaching & Career Development
This role is ideal for clinicians who enjoy contributing beyond clinical shifts.
You will have opportunities to:
  • supervise registrars, PHOs and junior medical staff
  • mentor ACEM trainees and SIMGs
  • participate in clinical governance and quality improvement
  • contribute to departmental education programs
  • engage in service redesign and innovation
  • support workplace-based assessments
  • participate in morbidity and mortality meetings
  • develop leadership and management skills
The Hospital and Health Service has strong links with:
  • The University of Queensland
  • CQUniversity
  • The Regional Medical Pathway program
There are excellent opportunities for:
  • academic involvement
  • simulation training
  • teaching appointments
  • regional workforce development
  • research participation
Private Practice Opportunities
Successful candidates may also have opportunities to establish private practice arrangements alongside their public appointment.
Support may include:
  • credentialling assistance
  • consulting room access
  • administrative setup support
  • referral pathway development
  • introductions to local specialists and GPs
This provides the opportunity to further develop professional interests and supplement income within a growing regional healthcare market.

Who We’re Looking For
We welcome applications from:
  • FACEMs
  • U.K, Irish, NZ and Canadian Emergency Physicians
  • SIMGs - ACEM specialist assessment MUST have substantially comparable outcome
The Ideal Candidate Will Demonstrate:
  • strong emergency clinical capability
  • excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • commitment to teaching and supervision
  • leadership within multidisciplinary environments
  • commitment to patient safety and quality care
  • enthusiasm for regional medicine
Why Doctors Relocate Here
  • improved work–life balance
  • reduced burnout
  • greater clinical autonomy
  • supportive department culture
  • lower cost of living
  • family-friendly lifestyle
  • stronger sense of community
This role represents an opportunity to practice meaningful Emergency Medicine in an environment where your contribution genuinely matters.

job.title: Consultant / Specialist Anaesthetist
job.description:
Consultant / Specialist Anaesthetist
Tropical North Queensland | Salary Package up to $500,000+

Where World-Class Medicine Meets a World-Class Lifestyle
Imagine finishing your theatre list and being on the Great Barrier Reef within the hour.

An exceptional opportunity exists for a Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist to join the major referral hospital for Tropical Queensland, based in a stunning coastal city.
Combining a rewarding specialist career with one of Australia's most desirable lifestyles, this role offers exposure to a diverse and complex caseload while enjoying year-round sunshine, tropical beaches, rainforest adventures and easy access to some of the world's most iconic natural attractions.

Why?
  • One of Australia's premier lifestyle destinations and serves as the gateway to both the Great Barrier Reef and the Wet Tropics Rainforest.
  • Live in a tropical coastal city with warm weather year-round
  • Explore the Great Barrier Reef on your days off
  • Discover World Heritage-listed rainforests, waterfalls and hiking trails
  • Enjoy beautiful beaches, island resorts and outdoor living
  • Vibrant café, restaurant and waterfront dining scene
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly communities
  • Affordable housing compared with Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane
Outstanding Connectivity
  • One of the major advantages of Cairns is its accessibility.
  • Direct flights to Brisbane (approximately 2 hours)
  • Direct flights to Sydney (approximately 3 hours)
  • Direct flights to Melbourne (approximately 3.5 hours)
  • Direct flights to Perth, Adelaide and Darwin
  • International connections to New Zealand, Bali, Singapore, Japan and other Asia-Pacific destinations
  • Modern international airport located just minutes from the city centre
Whether you're visiting family interstate, attending conferences or planning overseas travel, Cairns offers excellent national and international connectivity.

The Opportunity
This is the major tertiary referral centre for Far North Queensland, providing specialist services to a large and geographically diverse population.
As a Staff Specialist Anaesthetist you will:
  • Deliver specialist anaesthetic services across a broad range of surgical specialties
  • Participate in the Specialist Anaesthesia Outreach Program
  • Supervise and mentor junior doctors and trainees
  • Contribute to teaching, quality improvement and clinical governance
  • Work within a supportive multidisciplinary team
  • Play an important role in supporting healthcare delivery across regional and remote Queensland
Total remuneration packages can exceed $450,000–$500,000+ depending on experience, roster participation and private practice arrangements.

We welcome applications from:
  • FANZCA qualified specialists
  • ANZCA Specialist International Medical Graduates (SIMGs) assessed as Substantially Comparable
  • UK, Irish, New Zealand, South African and other internationally trained anaesthetists eligible for specialist registration pathways in Australia
Make the Move
If you're looking for a role that offers professional fulfilment, outstanding earning potential and a lifestyle that most people only experience on holiday, this could be the perfect next step.
To be considered for this role, please send your resume and cover letter to Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant, at nickiw@ccjobs.com.au or contact +61 401 010048.

job.title: Hospital Physiotherapist
job.description:
• Surgical/ortho inc some medical and ED 
  • ASAP start, full time role
  • 6 months ++ required, contract til July 2027
  • Accommodation available
  • 2 hours from Melbourne

 
Immediate vacancy for an experienced Physiotherapist to join a hospital just two hours from Melbourne.
 
Physiotherapist - Surgical Grade 2 position
  • Surgical ward -Fixed-term until June 2027. Open to candidates looking for 6 months ++. This role is largely based in surgical/orthopaedics but includes medical patients, some emergency department, paediatrics
  • The role is across general inpatients/outpatients across multiple areas as needed
  • Preference for >2 years experience at least, and have some public health/hospital experience 
  • Accommodation available, also possible relocation incentives >$2500, but up to $8000 for international relocation (existing visa/right to work) for longer term contracts
 
 
This role is largely responsible for delivering high-quality physiotherapy services to the surgical and acute care units, but will work as part of the wider acute physiotherapy team with additional responsibilities on the medical, respiratory, paediatric and maternity wards, the critical care unit and the emergency department as required.
 
Our team consists of physiotherapists, exercise physiologists and allied health assistants and delivers comprehensive services to the emergency, acute, subacute and community settings. As the Grade 2 Physiotherapist, you will work closely with the Grade 3 Acute Clinical Lead Physiotherapist and the Physiotherapy Manager to help oversee the delivery of Physiotherapy services across your clinical area. You will also work closely with other stakeholders such as the Nursing Unit Managers and different surgical and medical teams.
 
This role will provide support to Grade 1 Physiotherapists, Allied Health Assistants, Undergraduate Students, and the wider multi-disciplinary team. You will provide clinical expertise to complex cases, support staff supervision, assist with relevant competency and in-service training, and assist with departmental and organisation quality projects and/or working groups to enhance the delivery of high-quality physiotherapy services to GV Health patients in your relevant areas.
 
 


Hand Therapist (Physiotherapist & Occupational Therapist) – Grade 3 position
 
  • Role is Grade 3 and until December 2026, but open to discussions with Grade 2 staff or those seeking work post December 2026.
The Senior Hand Therapist will facilitate the triage, assessment and treatment of patients referred to the Hand Therapy Clinic, and will perform a leadership role in the provision, development and evaluation of evidence-based hand therapy services. They will work to achieve maximal operational effectiveness, to develop organisational competencies and guidelines, and supervise appropriate junior occupational therapy and physiotherapy staff undertaking hand therapy interventions, to ensure organisational service needs are met in a timely manner by appropriately skilled staff.
 
You will report directly to the Physiotherapy or Occupational Therapy Manager, and also work collaboratively with senior medical staff including Orthopaedics. You will work with other seniors in your relevant discipline and senior outpatient allied health staff to ensure effective teamwork and effective consumer care. Our services are patient-focused, efficient and effective, consistently meeting established standards of excellence.


 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.


To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

 
My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: URGENT Locum Hospital Occupational Therapist
job.description:
• 23rd June – 7th July
  • Rehabilitation caseload - neuro/cardiac/cancer/general recon
  • South Sydney location, close to transport links

 
Locum Hospital Occupational Therapist required for locum based in South Sydney hospital. 23rd June – 7th July. Monday – Friday, 8am – 4pm.
 
 
The inpatient rehabilitation caseload, will include:
  • It's a 31 bedded rehab ward and there is another OT also covering the caseload. Caseload varies from post-op rehab, ortho, neuro, cardiac, falls and general recon patients. 
  • You will provide initial assessments, functional reviews (personal care, meal prep, car transfers etc), discharge planning, attending MDT/case conferences. It involves working closely with Physios, Ex Physiologists, AHAs, nurses and Doctors. 
  • Ample street parking around the hospital and the train station is less than a 10 minute walk. 
  • Experience in private and/or public hospital required.
  • NO accommodation or travel available.
 
 
You must be able to cover a caseload independently. I’ve had great feedback from other locums! This role is not suitable for new graduates.

job.title: Specialist/Consultant Obstetrics & Gynaecology
job.description:
Rare FRANZCOG opportunity – Regional Obstetrics & Gynaecology role offering a package up to $679K and true broad-scope specialist practice in Tropical Sunny Queensland. For specialists looking to step away from high-volume metropolitan pressure, this role offers clinical autonomy, leadership opportunity and genuine work-life balance.
  • Specialist/Consultant – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
  • Total Package up to for FTE $679,000+ p.a.
  • Permanent Part-Time (20 hours per fortnight – 2 weeks block out of 8 weeks)
  • FREE Accommodation provided
An exceptional opportunity has opened for a Specialist Obstetrician & Gynaecologist to join a regional referral maternity service delivering around 420 births per year.
One of Queensland’s most unique regional centres — a vibrant outback community with modern amenities and a strong sense of connection.

Doctors are drawn here for the opportunity to:
  • Work in a close-knit multidisciplinary team
  • Enjoy short commutes and genuine work-life balance
  • Access world-class camping, fishing, national parks and outdoor adventure
This role offers something increasingly rare in modern specialist practice true breadth of clinical work, leadership influence and genuine community impact.

You will join a supportive rural specialist team delivering broad-scope obstetrics and gynaecology across inpatient, outpatient, theatre and outreach settings, while contributing to the training and supervision of junior doctors within accredited pathways.

For specialists seeking a role where their expertise is valued and their work makes a tangible difference, this is an outstanding career opportunity.

The Opportunity In this role you will:
  • Provide comprehensive obstetrics and gynaecology care including operative services
  • Perform point-of-care ultrasound across all trimesters
  • Deliver gynaecological surgical services and termination care
  • Participate in the specialist on-call roster
  • Supervise and mentor junior medical staff and trainees
  • Contribute to the development of a vital regional maternity service
Hospital acts as the regional birthing hub supporting remote communities across a vast catchment area.

Remuneration & Benefits Total remuneration up to $679,037 p.a. (pro-rata), including:
  • 50% Attraction & Retention Incentive
  • 15% Rural & Regional Allowance
  • 12.75% Superannuation
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • 5 weeks annual leave + 17.5% loading
  • 3.6 weeks professional development leave
  • Long service leave & sick leave accrual
  • Accommodation provided
  • Salary packaging options to maximise after-tax income

FRANZCOG a MUST
  • Experience across operative obstetrics and gynaecology
  • Ability to work in a regional multidisciplinary environment
  • C Class driver’s licence

How to Apply Please forward your resume and cover letter to Nicki Wade at nickiw@ccjobs.com.au, or contact her directly on 0401 010 048 for further information.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant

job.description:
• 29th June start date for 12 weeks
  • Outpatient, community and MSK caseload
  • Accommodation provided

 
New locum with this regional NSW service. The location is based two hours from Canberra and four hours from Sydney. 29th June start date for 12 weeks + possible extension.

The caseload will cover:
  • Musculoskeletal and outpatient groups in a public hospital setting
  • Transitional Aged Care Program (community based)
  • Possible outreach to smaller hospitals in the region
  • Support from senior clinicians available
  • Fun vibrant team and location

I have placed multiple locum and permanent allied health clinicians with the service and always get great feedback! Most choose to extend their placement.
 

Enjoy:
  • Competitive hourly rate + superannuation – rate based on experience!
  • Potential for living away from home benefits (more take home pay, upto $10 dollars more an hour!).
  • Heavily subsidised accommodation, approx $73.50 per week (close to the hospital)
  • Vibrant allied health team
  • Chance to develop your skill set
  • Several of my previous locums at this service have stayed long term as they have enjoyed the role and working environment
  • Up to $200 reimbursed for travel (with receipts)


Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

job.title: Locum Hospital Social Worker
job.description:
• 6th July for 6-8 weeks
  • Flights covered + FREE accommodation
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super

Experienced Social Worker required for this NT service. This is a remote 60 bed hospital. The service requires high level skills as a sole Social Worker and demonstrated cultural competence working respectfully with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population. There is a high incidence of domestic and family violence, child neglect and abuse reporting and statutory child removal. 6th July for 6-8 weeks + possible extension.
 
 
I’ve had great feedback from the 40+ allied health locums I’ve placed here over the years. To be considered, you must have:
 
  • Experience NOT including placements providing clinical social work services within a hospital setting (Emergency Department), including crisis intervention and short term support
  • Strong knowledge and experience in domestic and family violence risk assessment, safety planning and support services

job.title: Speech Pathologist – Community Paediatrics
job.description:
• June/July start for 4-6 month
  • $90,204 – $107,554 + superannuation
  • Community, outreach and indigenous caseload

 
 
Experienced Paediatric Speech Pathologist required for 4-6 month contract in Central Australia. You’ll be part of a team of 15 clinicians including 4 Speech Pathologists, 4 Occupational Therapists and 2 Physiotherapists. You will cover a caseload including:
  • Children 0-18 years with development delays in a community setting
  • Outreach to remote indigenous communities as part of multidisciplinary team
  • Community Adults with communication and swallowing difficulties (if you have the relevant experience)
 
The team provides allied health services (SP, OT and PT) to children and adults living in Central Australia. They service the urban area as well as the remote communities of Central Australia. As part of the role the therapist is required to travel to remote communities for up to a week at a time, approximately once a month. The caseload is varied and complex, and when in a remote community, the therapist will be the sole Speech Pathologist on the ground and so 2-3 years relevant experience is required.
 
You will work across community paediatrics - general not specialised involving:
  • Language delays
  • Pre diagnosis – early ASD
  • NDIS applications
  • Based in Alice Springs with some remote travel
 
They are a great team and work very collaboratively with each other and the many stakeholders and other providers involved in the lives of the children and families that they see.
 
Fixed term contract. Salary from $90,204 – $107,554 + superannuation (depending on experience). You’ll work Monday – Friday. A driving license is required for this role. A car will be provided for work purposes.
 
One way travel reimbursed. 4 weeks free accommodation and then subsidised accommodation available.

The location is a great base for exploring the natural wonders of the Outback including: Uluru, Kata Tjuta, Kings Canyon, the West MacDonnell Ranges and the Larapinta Trail, the Simpson Desert and the gorgeous NT watering holes. It’s also a fascinating spot to explore Australia’s Aboriginal culture.


Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

Applications are welcome from overseas-trained Paediatricians who have been assessed by the Royal Australasian College of Physicians (RACP) as Substantially Comparable OR those who are eligible via expedited pathway

An exceptional opportunity exists for a Consultant Paediatrician to join a regional health service in regional Victoria.
This is an opportunity to enjoy a rewarding specialist career while living in one of Victoria's most desirable regional locations. Offering an outstanding lifestyle, strong clinical support, and the opportunity to make a genuine impact on children's health services, this role is ideal for paediatricians seeking both professional fulfilment and work-life balance. Located just over two hours from Melbourne, this is the gateway to the spectacular Lakes, Ninety Mile Beach and the Victorian Alps. Enjoy affordable housing, excellent schools, beautiful natural surroundings and a welcoming community while remaining within easy reach of Melbourne.

Why?
  • Salary package up to $400,000+
  • Affordable housing and family-friendly lifestyle
  • Excellent schools and childcare options
  • Stunning beaches, lakes and outdoor recreation
  • Easy access to Melbourne and international airport connections
  • Strong clinical autonomy and influence
  • Supportive multidisciplinary environment
  • Leadership, teaching and service development opportunities
The Health Service
This well-established regional health service is the major provider of healthcare across the region and surrounding communities.
Services include:
  • More than 110 acute inpatient beds
  • Busy 24-hour Emergency Department
  • Intensive Care and Coronary Care services
  • Operating theatres and day procedure services
  • Oncology and Renal Dialysis services
  • Community and outreach programs
  • Comprehensive outpatient specialist services
The hospital maintains strong relationships with metropolitan tertiary centres and specialist retrieval services, ensuring excellent support for complex and subspecialty cases.

The Role
As a Consultant Paediatrician, you will provide comprehensive paediatric care across inpatient, outpatient and community settings.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • General paediatric inpatient management
  • Specialist outpatient clinics
  • Newborn and neonatal care
  • Developmental and behavioural paediatrics
  • Emergency Department consultations
  • Participation in paediatric on-call services
  • Multidisciplinary team collaboration
  • Clinical governance and quality improvement activities
  • Teaching, supervision and mentoring of junior doctors and medical students
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the ongoing development and expansion of paediatric services within a growing regional health service.

About You
You will possess:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians (FRACP) in Paediatrics and Child Health, or equivalent specialist qualifications
